title: Technical Product Manager, Agentic AI Security
description:
Technical Product Manager, Agentic AI Security

The Dell Security & Resiliency organization manages the security risk across all aspects of Dell’s business. We are currently experiencing incredible growth to meet the security needs of the world’s largest technology company. With team members located in over 15 countries, you will have an excellent opportunity to influence the security culture at Dell and further develop your career.

Join us as a Technical Product Manager, Agentic AI on our Dell Security & Resiliency Team in Round Rock, TX to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact

What you'll achieve:

We are seeking a Principal Technical Product Manager to hold the specification for security workflows being delivered as AI-native capabilities. This role owns what gets built and why: the requirements, the measurable outcomes, the acceptance criteria, the scope, and the standard a workflow must meet before it is ready to move into design and build.

The specification is the contract between the people whose process is changing and the engineers changing it. This role works with domain functional experts to establish what the work is, how it is performed today, and what a correct outcome looks like, and works alongside engineering to keep the specification buildable as design proceeds.

Specifications are expected to be written, verifiable, and current. A requirement that cannot be verified, an outcome that cannot be measured, or a scope boundary that has not been stated is not complete.

Objectives of This Role

  • A written specification for every workflow entering delivery, stating the requirements, the scope, and the outcomes the capability must produce

  • Acceptance criteria that state what the capability must do, expressed so that meeting them can be verified rather than debated

  • Measurable outcomes agreed with the functional owner before work starts, and evidenced after release

  • Scope held stable through delivery, with changes made deliberately and their cost stated

You will:

  • Own the specification for each workflow, covering the problem being solved, the requirements, the scope boundaries, the constraints, and the outcomes the capability must produce

  • Work with domain functional experts to establish how the work is performed today, what the process exists to achieve, where it varies, and what a correct result looks like, including the practice that has never been written down

  • Define acceptance criteria that state what the capability must do to be accepted, expressed in terms that can be verified rather than interpreted

  • Define the measurable outcomes for each workflow, including the baseline they are measured against and the improvement expected

  • Own the definition of ready: the standard a specification must meet before a workflow moves into design and build, and hold specifications to that standard rather than allowing incomplete work forward

  • Scope the work: separate what is required from what is desirable, state explicitly what is out of scope, and decompose large workflows into increments that can be delivered and used

  • Resolve conflicting requirements between functions rather than accumulating them into the specification, and record the decision and the reasoning behind it

  • Keep the specification current as design and delivery proceed, managing change deliberately and stating the cost of each change rather than absorbing it

  • Work alongside engineering through design and build so that specifications remain buildable, and revise the specification when a technical constraint makes the original requirement impractical

  • Validate delivered capability against the specification with the functional owner, and confirm after release whether the stated outcomes were achieved

  • Maintain the specification standard, templates, and reference examples so that each workflow after the first takes less effort to specify

Take the first step toward your dream career

Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here's what we're looking for in this role:

Essential Requirements

  • 8+ years in technical product management, product ownership, or business analysis for software systems, with specifications that engineering teams built directly from

  • Demonstrated ability to write requirements and acceptance criteria that are unambiguous and verifiable, and that do not require the author present to interpret them

  • Experience eliciting requirements from domain experts, including surfacing the tacit practice that experienced people apply without documenting

  • Experience defining measurable outcomes, including establishing a baseline and agreeing in advance what improvement will be measured and how

  • Experience scoping and decomposing large bodies of work into deliverable increments, and holding scope through delivery under pressure to expand it

  • Technical fluency sufficient to work with engineers on feasibility, constraints, and trade-offs, and to understand the systems being specified

  • Working knowledge of AI-native systems, including why their behavior is probabilistic and what that means for how requirements and acceptance criteria must be written

  • Demonstrated ability to resolve conflicting requirements between stakeholders and hold that decision

  • Written communication of a standard that engineering can build from without repeated clarification

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Desired Requirements

  • Experience in product management or business analysis within a security domain

  • Experience specifying AI or machine learning capabilities for production use

  • Experience with process analysis or process re-engineering, including documenting current state and defining a target state

  • Prior engineering or technical delivery background

  • Experience establishing specification standards or templates where none existed

  • Familiarity with LLM behavior, agentic systems, or AI evaluation practice

title: Software Engineer, Satellite Operations
description:
At Apple, we strive every single day to craft products that enrich people’s lives. Our successes are the result of skilled domain experts working in an environment which encourages creativity, collaboration, and re-thinking of old problems in new ways! As a member of the Satellite Connectivity Group, you will work on the satellite network that enables connectivity to iPhone and Watch Ultra when off the grid without cellular or Wi-Fi coverage. Every day, Apple customers use Emergency SOS, Roadside assistance, and Messages via satellite to stay connected when they have no other means to communicate. You will have the unique and rewarding opportunity to shape this and other critical services, to the benefit and safety of millions of Apple device users.

The Satellite Connectivity Group is hiring a software engineer to build automation and runtime infrastructure behind our communication satellite network. Our premise is that a satellite network should be run the way modern software services are run — through code, APIs, and instrumentation rather than manual console work. You will sit on the seam between the satellite network, the cloud services that connect to it, and our operations partners that control it.
You will partner with hardware, cloud, and operations teams on root-cause investigations. You will carry the pager for the systems you build. The software you write will be foundational for a connectivity service for millions of users worldwide.

You will join the team responsible for developing, deploying, and keeping connectivity services healthy end-to-end. On a given week you might trace a telemetry discrepancy from a cloud service through the ground system, script a new network test case, extend the continuous delivery (CD) pipeline that ships system health tooling, and write the procedure that lets the on-call engineer resolve the same issue next time without paging you. We expect the person in this seat to automate their own job continuously - to replace manual steps with tested code, and to leave behind procedures precise enough that someone else can execute correctly. You will work from design documents and interface control documents (ICDs), and you will be expected to reason through large, unfamiliar codebases on your own.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Aerospace Engineering
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including production Python
  • Experience with developing automation of (preferred) satellite constellations or fleets of autonomous vehicles/drones
  • Ability to independently navigate and reason about large, unfamiliar code repositories spanning both embedded and cloud-based software
  • Hands-on fluency with Linux and Mac OS, cloud service APIs, modern command-line usage and HTTP tooling
  • Experience working with CI and production CD pipelines for a software service
  • Experience using design documents and ICDs as foundations for an operational service
  • Export Compliance Requirement: This position requires access to U.S. export-controlled technology and technical data regulated under the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Applicants must be eligible to access this export-controlled information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience operating a satellite constellation in production, serving real users
  • Embedded software development, and hands-on work with hardware in a lab environment
  • Working knowledge of RF and DSP concepts, sufficient to reason about satellite system behavior
  • Small, fast-moving space programs where operations engineers write and own the software they operate
  • Experience leading, or serving as a core member of, a 24/7 operations team
  • Building an SOP or runbook framework from scratch, not just executing an existing one
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to quickly reason about and prototype new systems

title: Assistant, Finance
description:
Job Title: Assistant, Finance

Department: Finance
Reporting To: Dina Patel
Location: London, UK
Hybrid Working: Minimum of 3 days in the office
Full-time | Permanent

The Role

We’re looking for two Finance Assistants to join our Global Finance team in London.

You’ll support the day-to-day Accounts Payable and Finance operations across our UK and US businesses, helping to ensure invoices, payments, expenses and reconciliations are processed accurately and on time.

Working closely with colleagues across Finance and the wider business, you’ll gain hands-on experience across purchase ledger, payment processing, client payments and reconciliations while developing a strong understanding of Kobalt’s global Finance operations.

This is a great opportunity for someone early in their Finance career who wants to build their technical accounting experience within a fast-paced, global music and technology company.

What You’ll Do

  • Process UK and US invoices accurately and on time using NetSuite.
  • Match invoices against purchase orders and ensure appropriate supporting information and approvals are in place.
  • Support the preparation and execution of supplier payment runs, currently completed twice a week.
  • Process payments using Kyriba, our Treasury management system.
  • Prepare and manage payments to Kobalt clients.
  • Complete supplier statement reconciliations and investigate discrepancies.
  • Support bank and account reconciliations.
  • Process employee expenses accurately and promptly.
  • Produce timely purchase ledger reports and maintain accurate financial records.
  • Input relevant financial information into Kobalt’s internal systems, including our royalties database.
  • Respond to internal and external queries relating to invoices, suppliers and payments, taking ownership of issues through to resolution where appropriate.
  • Ensure activity is completed in line with Kobalt’s Finance processes, procedures and controls.
  • Support colleagues across the broader Finance team with ad-hoc tasks and projects.
  • Identify opportunities to make Finance processes simpler, more accurate and more efficient.

What You’ll Bring

Preferred:

  • Experience working within a Finance, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable or similar environment.
  • An understanding of purchase ledger or transactional Finance processes.
  • Confidence working with numerical and financial data with strong attention to detail.
  • Good Excel skills and confidence learning new financial systems.
  • Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and competing priorities.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders.
  • A proactive approach to resolving queries and discrepancies.
  • The ability to adapt and work effectively within a fast-paced Finance environment.
  • An interest in developing a career within Finance and Accounting.

Additional Skills That Could Add Value:

  • Experience using NetSuite or a similar accounting system.
  • Experience using Kyriba or another Treasury management system.
  • Experience processing supplier or client payments.
  • Experience completing supplier statement or bank reconciliations.
  • Experience working with multi-currency payments or within an international Finance environment.
  • Familiarity with digital Finance, automation or expense-management tools.

What Success Looks Like

By Month 3: You’ll understand Kobalt’s core Finance processes and systems and be accurately processing invoices, expenses and payments with appropriate support.

By Month 6: You’ll be confidently managing your core responsibilities, completing reconciliations, supporting payment runs and resolving routine queries with increasing independence.

By Year 1: You’ll be a trusted member of the Finance team, consistently delivering accurate and timely work and proactively identifying opportunities to improve Finance processes and ways of working.

Key Behaviours for Success

Time Management & Prioritisation – You organise your workload effectively and can manage recurring deadlines and competing priorities within a busy Finance environment.

Problem-Solving & Initiative – You investigate discrepancies and queries rather than simply passing them on and are curious about how processes could work better.

Collaboration & Communication – You work effectively with colleagues across Finance and the wider business, communicate clearly and contribute positively to the team.

Professional Development

We’re committed to supporting your continued development within Finance. If you’re interested in pursuing a professional accounting qualification such as ACA, ACCA or CIMA, Kobalt can support you through your qualification, including eligible study materials, course and examination fees and paid study leave in line with our study support policy.

Interview Process

  • Introductory call with a member of our Recruitment Team
  • Interview with the hiring manager and Finance team
  • Final stage interview
  • Feedback at each stage

We aim to complete the full interview process from initial application to offer within three working weeks. While we do our best to meet this timeline, there may be occasional delays. If that happens, our Recruitment Team will keep you updated every step of the way.

Why Choose Us

At Kobalt, we’ve championed creators since 2000. Our technology and music services are built to make the industry more transparent, fair and rewarding for artists, songwriters and rights holders. We’re proud to work with some of the world’s most influential talents including Phoebe Bridgers, Sam Fender, Paul McCartney, Foo Fighters, Karol G, Young Thug, Kali Uchis and Andrew Watt as well as acclaimed writers like Simon Aldred (Rag’n’Bone Man, Liam Gallagher, Celeste) and Clarence Coffee Jr. (Dua Lipa, Lizzo, The Snuts).

We’re a company that thrives on creativity, collaboration and progress. Our values — Music First, Transparent, Tech Powered and Transformative — shape how we work, build and grow together. We are a community of people who care deeply about making a meaningful impact in music and technology.

Kobalt is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in equitable access to opportunities and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and supportive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re happy to help.

If this sounds like you, then please share your story by filling out the application below.

Important Notice

Applicants must be eligible to work in the United Kingdom. A full DBS check will be conducted on acceptance of the offer. Kobalt is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any status or characteristic protected by law.

description:

High Voltage Electronics Engineer Intern - Onsite

Job Summary: GM Performance Power Units is seeking a motivated High Voltage Electronics Engineer Intern to join our ERS (Energy Recovery System) team in Concord, NC. This internship supports the build of an Analog HV Battery Control Box benchtop training and test rig — a hands-on platform that will train new engineers and technicians on high-voltage safety fundamentals and characterize HV subsystems ahead of vehicle integration. You'll work alongside experienced electrical engineers across the build phases, gaining direct exposure to analog safety-critical design, PCB layout for high voltage, and HV commissioning practices used in a Formula 1 power unit program.

Key Responsibilities

Support schematic capture and component selection for the discrete-analog HV safety path (precharge, contactor drive, HVIL) under the direction of the build lead.
Assist with PCB layout reviews for HV creepage/clearance compliance (IEC 60664) and help document design margins.
Help draft and pilot-test procedures for the HV training curriculum modules (safety fundamentals, precharge, IMD operation, contactor sequencing).
Participate in bench testing and data collection during rig commissioning, under direct supervision of a certified HV-competent engineer.
Document test results, build progress, and design decisions to support the safety case review package.
Support characterization studies on HV subsystems as the rig transitions to broader ERS test capability.
Observe and assist with HV safety procedures (LOTO, HVIL checks, insulation-resistance testing) to build foundational HV safety competency.
Additional tasks as needed.

Required Qualifications

Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline.
Coursework or lab project experience in analog circuit design (op-amps, comparators, discrete logic).
Basic understanding of electrical safety principles; willingness to complete GMPPU HV safety certification prior to any hands-on HV work.
Strong attention to detail and disciplined documentation habits.
Ability to work on-site in Concord, NC for the duration of the internship.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior project experience with PCB design tools (Altium, KiCad, or similar).
Exposure to lab test equipment (oscilloscopes, multimeters, bench power supplies).
Coursework or project experience involving high-voltage or battery systems (e.g., Formula SAE Electric, EV club, robotics team).
Familiarity with IEC 60664 or similar electrical safety standards.
Interest in motorsport, EV powertrains, or hybrid systems.

Physical Requirements

Ability to stand, walk, and move in diverse operational environments, including race shops, arenas, and commercial facilities.

Interns will have the unique opportunity to work on a team poised to showcase American engineering excellence on the global Formula 1 stage.

title: VP, Clinical Integrity
description:
Vice President, Clinical Integrity
Department: Clinical Intelligence – Management
Location: Remote
FLSA Status: Exempt
People Leader: Yes
Travel: Less than 5%
Summary
Company Summary
Accuity partners with hospitals and health systems through a technology-enabled, physician-led model that improves clinical documentation integrity, coding accuracy, reimbursement optimization, and quality outcomes.
Job Summary
The Vice President, Clinical Integrity is a senior physician executive responsible for establishing and advancing Accuity’s clinical integrity strategy, governance framework, and clinical risk and compliance standards. Reporting to the Chief Medical Officer/Chief Medical Information Officer, this role provides enterprise leadership for the clinical accuracy, defensibility, consistency, and responsible use of Clinical Intelligence capabilities. The role also leads the Clinical Integrity escalation and disagreement function and provides consultative physician support to related cross-functional workflows.
The VP, Clinical Integrity sets standards, decision frameworks, and oversight practices that support clinically accurate and compliant outcomes across technology-enabled workflows, ensuring best practices and efficiency gains are realized. Key performance expectations include leading cross-functional efforts to reduce avoidable or recurrent internal and client disagreements by 50%, measured by both case count and dollar impact against agreed baselines; achieve 95% or higher compliance on applicable third-party and client audits; achieve 80% or higher actualization of high-value, compliant changes; and develop and implement best practices for contingency-fee clients that support the actualization of compliant changes. These goals must be pursued without compromising clinical accuracy, coding compliance, or appropriate escalation. Baselines, timeframes, attribution, and measurement methodologies will be established with executive leadership and the relevant functional owners.
This leader partners with Clinical Operations, Product, Analytics, Compliance, and client-facing teams to ensure clinical requirements are translated into scalable solutions, risks are appropriately managed, and performance remains aligned with clinical, regulatory, operational, and business expectations.
Responsibilities
Clinical Integrity and Governance

  • Establish and maintain enterprise standards for clinical accuracy, integrity, defensibility, and evidence-based decision-making.
  • Develop governance frameworks that define clinical review, validation, approval, escalation, and accountability requirements.
  • Set standards for the appropriate interpretation and use of clinical documentation, including the management of ambiguity, attribution, timing, and uncertainty.
  • Ensure Clinical Intelligence capabilities and outputs remain aligned with accepted clinical practices, organizational policies, and client expectations.
  • Chair or lead governance forums that evaluate clinical priorities, risks, exceptions, and material decisions.
  • Maintain clear documentation of governance decisions, standards, and approval authorities.

Escalation, Disagreement Resolution, and Clinical Standards

  • Lead the Clinical Integrity escalation and disagreement team and establish consistent expectations for intake, triage, review, documentation, turnaround time, decision-making, and reporting.
  • Support the remediation and rebuttal process for escalated clinical or coding disagreements between physician reviewers and Documentation Integrity Specialists (DIS), including cases elevated through their respective management teams.
  • Provide consultative physician support in resolving disagreements between tower CDI staff and physician reviewers, including development or review of clinically and coding-defensible rebuttals; tower and operational leaders retain ownership of day-to-day workflow and implementation.
  • Provide clinical subject-matter expertise and case-preparation support to the Denials and Appeals team for selected payer peer-to-peer reviews and Administrative Law Judge (ALJ) proceedings; the Denials and Appeals team retains program and workflow ownership.
  • Partner with the clinical content librarian, Knowledge Management, CDI, Coding, and other subject-matter experts to support and help coordinate formal review and updating of clinical criteria at least every six months, and sooner when changes in evidence, regulation, policy, or client requirements warrant.
  • Exercise delegated authority for routine escalations within approved standards and elevate unresolved, precedent-setting, high-risk, or clinically material matters to the CMO/CMIO, who retains final clinical decision authority.
  • Analyze disagreement, rebuttal, and escalation themes and communicate actionable feedback to clinical, coding, CDI, education, quality, product, and operational leaders.

Clinical Risk and Compliance

  • Provide executive oversight of clinical risks associated with Clinical Intelligence programs, workflows, and technology-enabled solutions.
  • Establish risk-assessment and control practices designed to identify, evaluate, mitigate, and monitor clinically meaningful issues.
  • Partner with Compliance, Legal, Quality, and operational leaders to ensure clinical practices support applicable requirements and organizational standards.
  • Define escalation and response expectations for incidents that may affect clinical accuracy, defensibility, quality, or client outcomes.
  • Oversee clinical input into root-cause analysis, corrective action planning, and preventive control development.
  • Advise executive leadership on significant clinical risks, emerging trends, and recommended actions.

Strategy and Organizational Leadership

  • Develop and execute the Clinical Integrity strategy in alignment with Accuity’s broader Clinical Intelligence, clinical, product, operational, and business priorities.
  • Translate enterprise objectives into clear clinical priorities, governance expectations, and measurable outcomes.
  • Provide executive guidance on investments, sequencing, tradeoffs, and organizational capabilities needed to support sustainable growth.
  • Monitor changes in healthcare, clinical documentation, technology, and industry practices that may affect Accuity’s clinical strategy or risk profile.
  • Establish operating rhythms and executive reporting that provide visibility into performance, risks, decisions, and progress.
  • Serve as a senior clinical advisor to the CMO/CMIO and executive leadership team.

Product and Technology Oversight

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Data Science leaders to embed clinical requirements and safeguards into technology-enabled solutions.
  • Ensure clinical requirements are clearly defined, appropriately validated, and incorporated into development and implementation practices.
  • Establish clinical readiness and approval expectations for new capabilities, material changes, and production releases.
  • Provide clinical oversight for AI-enabled and data-driven capabilities, including expectations for responsible use, monitoring, and ongoing evaluation.
  • Guide the development of performance measures that assess clinical accuracy, consistency, reliability, and operational impact.
  • Ensure material clinical risks and limitations are understood, documented, and addressed before deployment or expansion.

Cross-Functional and Client Leadership

  • Build strong partnerships across Clinical Operations, Product, Technology, Analytics, Compliance, Quality, and client-facing functions.
  • Align clinical standards with operational workflows, implementation needs, and client commitments.
  • Provide executive clinical guidance for complex client issues, escalations, and strategic discussions.
  • Communicate clinical standards, risks, decisions, and recommendations clearly to technical, operational, executive, and client audiences.
  • Support clinically grounded narratives and materials that strengthen confidence in Accuity’s services and solutions.
  • Promote shared accountability for clinical integrity across functions.

Leadership and People Management

  • Lead and develop the Clinical Integrity escalation and disagreement function, including physician, clinical, coding, and operational professionals, as applicable.
  • Establish clear team structure, decision rights, performance expectations, and accountability.
  • Recruit, coach, and retain leaders and subject-matter experts capable of supporting current and future business needs.
  • Build team capability in clinical judgment, governance, risk management, quality oversight, and cross-functional execution.
  • Ensure effective delegation, succession planning, workload management, and coverage across programs and clinical domains.
  • Foster a culture of transparency, disciplined decision-making, continuous improvement, and accountability within a fully remote environment.

Operational Excellence

  • Establish measures and reporting that evaluate clinical quality, risk, governance effectiveness, and program performance.
  • Review trends, incidents, audit results, and other performance indicators to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Ensure clinical standards and controls remain scalable as programs, clients, and technology capabilities evolve.
  • Sponsor improvement initiatives that strengthen clinical accuracy, consistency, efficiency, and adoption.
  • Maintain disciplined documentation and follow-through for significant decisions, risks, and actions.

Other Duties as Assigned

  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Qualifications
Education and Credentials

  • Doctor of Medicine or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine degree required.
  • Current board certification in a recognized medical specialty required.
  • Active, unrestricted medical license required.
  • Formal training or certification in clinical informatics, healthcare quality, compliance, patient safety, or a related discipline preferred.

Experience

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in physician leadership, clinical operations, clinical informatics, healthcare technology, or a related healthcare environment.
  • Experience with clinical documentation integrity, coding, revenue cycle, or health-system workflows required.
  • Executive-level experience leading multidisciplinary teams and complex, cross-functional clinical programs.
  • Demonstrated success establishing clinical governance, quality, risk, or compliance frameworks.
  • Experience translating clinical requirements into scalable operational, product, or technology standards.
  • Experience with AI-enabled healthcare solutions, data-driven clinical tools, or clinical decision support preferred.

Core Competencies

  • Executive Clinical Leadership: Provides credible, enterprise-level clinical guidance and influences decisions across functions.
  • Clinical Judgment: Applies sound physician judgment to complex questions involving documentation, evidence, ambiguity, and clinical risk.
  • Governance: Establishes clear standards, decision rights, controls, and accountability mechanisms.
  • Risk and Compliance Orientation: Anticipates clinical and regulatory risks and develops practical approaches to manage them.
  • Strategic Thinking: Connects clinical priorities to organizational strategy, client needs, technology direction, and business outcomes.
  • Decision-Making: Makes timely, well-reasoned decisions and clearly communicates the basis, implications, and required actions.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Builds alignment across clinical, operational, technical, compliance, and commercial teams.
  • Communication: Communicates complex clinical and technical matters clearly to executive, professional, and client audiences.
  • Stakeholder Management: Develops trusted relationships and balances competing priorities while protecting clinical integrity.
  • Change Leadership: Guides teams through evolving technology, workflows, standards, and organizational expectations.
  • People Leadership: Sets direction, develops talent, manages performance, and builds sustainable team capability.
  • Execution Discipline: Converts strategy into priorities, governance practices, measurable outcomes, and consistent follow-through.
  • Remote-Work Effectiveness: Leads with visibility, responsiveness, structure, and accountability in a fully remote organization.

Additional Requirements
1) Physical Requirements: The requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job with or without reasonable accommodations. Unless otherwise indicated, Accuity positions require interaction with people and technology while either sitting or standing. Employees must be able to communicate via phone, email, etc. and sit for extended periods of time, with or without reasonable accommodations. Physical effort and exposure to physical risk are limited to that of an office role / environment.
2) Position and Employment Statement: While this job description is intended to be an accurate reflection of the job requirements, management reserves the right to modify, add or remove duties from a job and to assign other duties as necessary and at any time. All positions at Accuity Delivery Systems, LLC, are at-will employment, and a position description is not a guarantee of a job or of job responsibilities.

title: Design Verification Engineer
description:
At Apple, we work every single day to craft products that enrich people’s lives. Do you love working on challenges that no one has solved yet and changing the game? We have an opportunity for an outstandingly hardworking design verification engineer! As a member of our wide-ranging group, you will have the rare and extraordinary opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and encourage millions of Apple’s customers daily.

This role is for a DV engineer who will enable us to produce fully functional first silicon for IP designs. The responsibilities include all phases of pre-silicon verification including but not limited to: establishing DV methodology, test-plan development, verification environment development including stimulus and checkers, test-writing, debug, coverage, sign-off for RTL freeze and tape-out.

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring bug-free first silicon for part of the SoC / IP and are encouraged to develop detailed test and coverage plans based on the micro-architecture. You are responsible for developing verification methodology suitable for the IP, ensuring a scalable and portable environment. You will get to develop verification environment, including all the respective components such as stimulus, checkers, assertions, trackers, coverage. A mindset to break the design is highly desirable.

Furthermore, you will develop verification plans for all features under your care, execute verification plans, including design bring-up, DV environment bring- up, regression enabling features, and debug of the test failures. You will also learn to develop block, IP and SoC level test-benches track and report DV progress using a variety of metrics, including bugs and coverage. You will also be expected to make use of LLM and related technologies to achieve efficient execution and improved quality.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS degree in technical subject area and a minimum 10 years relevant industry experience or equivalent.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep knowledge of OOP, SystemVerilog and UVM
  • Deep knowledge in developing scalable and portable test-benches
  • Strong experience with verification methodologies and tools such as simulators, waveform viewers, Build and run automation, coverage collection, gate level simulations
  • Working experience using LLMs for efficiency and quality
  • Experience with power-aware (UPF) or similar verification methodology
  • Excellent knowledge of one of the scripting languages such as Python, Perl, TCL
  • Experience with serial protocols such as PCIe or USB, parallel protocol such as DDR is a plus but not required
  • Knowledge of formal verification methodology is a plus but not required
  • Knowledge of emulation for verification technologies is a plus but not required

title: Director of Philanthropy West Coast

Rooted in the belief that reproductive choice is foundational to gender equality, education, economic opportunity, and overall well-being, MSI Reproductive Choices empowers women and families to make informed decisions about their futures.

MSI United States, the organization’s US-based fundraising arm, has entered a remarkable period of philanthropic momentum and growth. In 2025 alone, the Global Philanthropy Team raised more than £135 million globally, including $38.7 million from US-based donors, while significantly expanding its donor pipeline and engagement efforts. Working collaboratively with colleagues across the United States and internationally, the Director will help grow a portfolio valued at more than $2 million while strengthening MSI’s visibility and engagement among West Coast philanthropists and supporters.

title: Tech Lead - Platform Engineer
description:
About the role

We're looking for a Lead Platform Engineer to drive the technical direction of Carbon Health's core platform and foundational services: the backend systems, service-to-service communication, and infrastructure that every product team builds on.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll set architectural direction, make pragmatic decisions about reliability and scale, and still write and review code alongside the team.

You'll work in a JVM-based microservices environment on AWS, in a healthcare setting where availability, data integrity, and security directly affect patient care.


What you'll do

  • Lead technical work on building and scaling Carbon Health's core platform and foundational services.
  • Drive architectural decisions for highly available, scalable backend systems, and document them so the whole team understands the trade-offs.
  • Shape how services talk to each other: gRPC contracts and their evolution, deadlines and timeouts, retries with backoff, idempotency, and graceful degradation when a dependency fails.
  • Design event-driven and asynchronous workflows that stay consistent under failure, using patterns such as idempotent consumers, dead-letter handling, Saga, and Transactional Outbox.
  • Own the platform's infrastructure as code: set Terraform standards and module structure, review infrastructure changes like application code, and keep environments reproducible.
  • Build and improve CI/CD pipelines so teams can ship small changes to production quickly and safely.
  • Define service-level objectives with the team and make services observable through metrics, structured logging, distributed tracing, and actionable alerting.
  • Lead incident response and blameless post-mortems, and turn their findings into lasting reliability improvements.
  • Guide data design across relational databases, caches, and search stores, keeping performance predictable as data grows.
  • Make security and compliance part of the platform: access control, encryption, secrets management, and audit trails for sensitive healthcare data.
  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and pairing, and provide technical leadership across backend and frontend domains.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and fast, reliable delivery.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience designing, building, and operating backend or distributed systems in production.
  • 2+ years of experience in a technical leadership role.
  • Strong experience with microservice architectures on AWS.
  • Proficiency in at least one strongly typed JVM language, preferably Kotlin, Scala, or Java.
  • Hands-on experience with gRPC or a similar RPC framework, including contract design, timeouts, retries, and failure handling between services.
  • Experience with event-driven architecture and message queues, and with the delivery and consistency challenges that come with them.
  • Solid experience with relational databases (schema design, indexing, query performance), plus caching and search data stores.
  • Hands-on experience managing infrastructure with Terraform.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience running services in production: observability, incident response, and root-cause analysis.
  • Ability to work as an independent technical leader, designing and delivering new capabilities with a distributed team.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, both written and verbal.

    Qualifications
  • Experience in healthcare technology or other highly regulated industries.
  • Experience with healthcare data standards such as HL7 or FHIR.
  • Experience with resilience patterns such as circuit breakers, bulkheads, and rate limiting.
  • Experience with stream processing or change data capture.
  • Experience with containers and container orchestration.
  • Experience reducing cloud costs or improving network and security posture at the platform level.
  • A strong interest in using AI efficiently and responsibly in software development and engineering workflows.

What we offer

  • Remote-first, full-time, permanent employment in Türkiye.
  • Salary paid in USD, net.
  • Payroll employment with the benefits of a permanent position.
  • Access to our office at ODTÜ Teknokent, Ankara, with regular visits according to planned schedules.
  • 100% private health insurance coverage for the employee.
  • 50% private health insurance coverage for eligible family members, if you choose to include them.
  • Floating vacation days: when a public holiday falls on a weekend, you can take the corresponding day off on a weekday of your choice, subject to applicable policies.
  • The opportunity to shape the foundations of meaningful healthcare technology products with a collaborative engineering team.

title: Managing Consultant, Palantir Data & AI Engineer
description:
Thought Logic Consulting is a functionally-led, digitally enabled consultancy that exists at the intersection of business transformation and technology innovation. We partner with clients to solve their most complex business problems through a highly collaborative, local-market approach, giving clients senior-level attention and giving our consultants room to grow, lead, and build.

The Role
We are looking for a technically skilled and motivated Managing Consultant with hands-on Palantir experience to join our growing Data & Analytics team. In this role, you will work directly with clients to design, build, and deploy solutions using Palantir Foundry and, where applicable, Palantir AIP. You will translate complex business problems into production-ready data and AI solutions, lead project workstreams, and help clients turn their data into measurable business outcomes.

What You'll Do
  • Design, build, and deploy scalable data and AI solutions using Palantir Foundry, with emphasis on Foundry data pipelines, data modeling, and operational workflows.
  • Develop and prototype GenAI- and LLM-powered solutions using Palantir AIP and related enterprise AI capabilities.
  • Embed with client teams to identify high-value use cases, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and lead working sessions with senior stakeholders.
  • Build production-quality data and AI applications using strong engineering practices including testing, CI/CD, version control, logging, documentation, and performance optimization.
  • Develop agentic AI workflows, tool-use patterns, and human-in-the-loop controls while balancing quality, safety, latency, cost, and model risk.
  • Integrate Palantir solutions with enterprise systems, cloud platforms, APIs, microservices, and data sources to create reliable end-to-end solutions.
  • Lead project workstreams and mentor team members while creating reusable Palantir assets, implementation patterns, documentation, and reference solutions.
  • Client executives, business leaders, product owners, architects, engineers, and data teams focused on modernizing data and AI capabilities.
  • Palantir-focused delivery teams working across Foundry, AIP, data engineering, AI, and application development.
  • Cross-functional client teams where you will operate directly in the business to understand problems and rapidly deliver working solutions.
  • Experienced Thought Logic consultants and technical leaders who provide architectural guidance, delivery support, and mentorship.
  • Organizations looking to operationalize Palantir Foundry and AI capabilities to improve mission-critical business processes and decision-making.
  • Technical and non-technical stakeholders who need complex data and AI concepts translated into practical, business-focused solutions.
  • A collaborative consulting environment that values curiosity, ownership, hands-on problem solving, and measurable client outcomes.
  • Professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, analytics engineering, data science, or a related technical discipline.
  • Hands-on Palantir experience, including meaningful implementation experience with Palantir Foundry and/or Palantir AIP.
  • Experience building and deploying production GenAI/LLM-powered solutions and translating business problems into practical AI use cases.
  • Strong data engineering fundamentals including SQL, Python or another scripting language, ETL/ELT, data modeling, data integration, and data quality.
  • Experience with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud and modern data technologies such as Spark, Airflow/dbt, streaming, or similar platforms.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; ability to legally work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship.
Bonus Points if You Have
  • Palantir certifications, advanced Foundry experience, or experience with Palantir AIP, Maven, or other Palantir products.
  • Experience developing ontology-driven applications, operational workflows, or applications directly within the Palantir Foundry ecosystem.
  • Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, including model evaluation, monitoring, prompt management, experimentation, and model risk considerations.
  • Experience integrating LLM solutions with enterprise systems through APIs, microservices, or event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, Redshift, Kafka, Power BI, Tableau, or comparable modern data technologies.
  • Experience with agentic AI frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, or human-in-the-loop AI patterns.
  • Previous consulting firm experience and a track record of delivering technology solutions directly alongside client technical teams.
  • Work on meaningful Palantir, data, and AI transformations—not slide decks that sit on shelves.
  • Take real ownership of how solutions are designed, built, delivered, and experienced by clients.
  • Work directly with senior client stakeholders and technical teams on high-impact business problems.
  • Grow your expertise across Palantir Foundry, AIP, data engineering, GenAI, and modern cloud technologies.
  • Have direct access to firm leadership and influence how our Palantir and Data & Analytics capabilities grow.
  • Join a culture that values depth over optics, outcomes over activity, and people over process.
  • Build your career in a firm that is scaling thoughtfully and intentionally while giving consultants room to lead and build.

Experienced professional who knows how to apply theory and put it into practice with in-depth understanding of the professional field; independently performs the full range of responsibilities within the function; possesses broad job knowledge; analyzes problems / issues of diverse scope and determines solutions.

title: Vice President, Transactions & Transitions
description: Position Summary The Vice President, Transactions & Transitions is responsible for leading the cross-functional execution of real estate transactions and asset transitions across the enterprise. The position serves as the central coordination point for capital events, ownership and portfolio changes, property management transitions, and other significant events that require coordinated action across multiple business lines and corporate departments. The VP ensures that transactions and transitions move from decision through closing, implementation, and operational stabilization in a disciplined and consistent manner. The role establishes governance, timelines, accountability, readiness standards, and handoffs while ensuring that business owners and functional leaders remain accountable for the substantive work within their respective areas. The VP reports to the Chief Operating Officer, has direct reports supporting transaction and transition execution, and works closely with business-line and functional leaders across the enterprise. Primary Areas of Responsibility Transactions Lead enterprise coordination and execution planning for significant real estate transactions, including: Acquisitions Sales and dispositions Portfolio acquisitions or dispositions Ownership changes and entity restructurings GP/LP or fund ownership changes Year-15 and similar ownership transitions Refinancings and recapitalizations where significant cross-functional coordination is required Other transactions requiring coordinated operational implementation For each transaction, establish the enterprise workplan, identify required functional deliverables, track dependencies and deadlines, surface risks, and coordinate readiness through closing. Asset and Management Transitions Lead major operational transitions affecting properties or portfolios, including: Change in property management company Transition from third-party management to in-house management Transition from in-house management to third-party management Change between third-party management companies Acquisition onboarding Disposition offboarding Significant regulatory or ownership conversions requiring operational transition May be added at a later date: Construction completion and turnover to Property Management; New development lease-up and stabilization; Major rehabilitation or repositioning transitions; and Portfolio transfers between internal operating teams Establish transition plans covering people, systems, data, financial operations, vendors, contracts, resident operations, compliance, technology, insurance, reporting, and documentation. Transaction & Transition Governance Develop and maintain a standardized enterprise framework for transactions and transitions, including: Transaction and transition playbooks Standard workplans and checklists Functional deliverables RACI matrices Stage gates and readiness reviews Closing readiness requirements Day 1 / Day 30 / Day 60 / Day 90 plans Escalation protocols Executive reporting Post-transition reviews and lessons learned Establish clear accountability by function and ensure that required activities are completed before major milestones. Cross-Functional Leadership and Accountability Serve as the central transaction and transition lead across participating teams, including: Business Lines: Fund Management; Development (3); Asset Management; Property Management; Construction Corporate Departments: Legal; Finance; Property Accounting; Corporate Accounting; Treasury; Tax; HR / Payroll; IT; Yardi / Business Applications; Data & Reporting; Insurance / Risk Management Departments within Property Management: Compliance; Residential Leasing; Marketing / Communications; Contract Administration; Procurement and Vendor ManagementPartner with functional leaders across these teams to establish required deliverables, owners, deadlines, dependencies, and readiness standards for each transaction or transition.Operational Readiness Ensure that the organization is operationally prepared for each closing or transition. Partner with the appropriate functional leads including business lines, corporate departments, and departments within business lines to confirm readiness. The VP is responsible for coordinating and monitoring readiness across these functions. Functional leaders remain responsible for completing the work within their respective teams. Data & Document Readiness Establish standards for the information that must be collected, validated, transferred, and retained for each transaction or transition. Ensure that: Required information is identified early in the process. Functional owners are assigned for each data element or document. Information is maintained in designated systems of record. Historical transaction and transition records are retained. Data required for ongoing operations and reporting is complete at handoff. Partner with IT, Data, Accounting, Asset Management, Property Management, and other business teams to improve the consistency and automation of transition data. Risk & Issue Management Maintain visibility into risks that could affect closing, Day 1 operations, resident experience, compliance, financial reporting, or asset performance. Develop and maintain an enterprise-level issue and risk log and ensure that significant issues have a designated owner, resolution plan, target date, appropriate escalation, and executive visibility when necessary. Drive cross-functional resolution of issues that affect multiple teams or require executive decision-making. Executive Reporting Provide concise reporting to executive leadership regarding: upcoming transactions and transitions; major milestones; closing readiness; operational readiness; at risk deliverables; outstanding executive decisions; material risks; and post-closing stabilization. Develop and maintain a consolidated enterprise transaction and transition pipeline that provides leadership with visibility across the portfolio. Process Improvement Conduct post-transaction and post-transition reviews to identify recurring issues and opportunities for improvement. Use lessons learned to continuously improve: processes, checklists, systems, data requirements, contract requirements, contact provisions, due diligence requirements, functional responsibilities, transition timelines. Identify opportunities to automate workflows, improve handoffs, and eliminate duplicative manual processes. Qualifications Significant experience in real estate transactions, asset management, property management, development, operations, or transaction/project management. Strong understanding of multifamily real estate operations; affordable housing experience strongly preferred. Experience coordinating complex acquisitions, dispositions, management transitions, or portfolio integrations. Experience leading and developing direct reports. Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives without relying solely on direct reporting authority. Strong project and program management skills. Ability to understand financial, operational, legal, technology, compliance, and organizational dependencies. Strong executive communication and escalation skills. Ability to establish repeatable processes while adapting to transaction-specific requirements. Additional Knowledge, Skills & AbilitiesThe successful candidate should be: Highly organized and execution-oriented Comfortable operating across business lines Able to challenge functional leaders constructively Skilled at identifying dependencies and risks before they become problems Strong at translating complex transactions into clear operational workplans Comfortable working with senior executives Able to lead and develop direct reports while influencing broader cross-functional teams Able to distinguish between coordination responsibility and functional ownership Strong at driving accountability without directly managing all participating teams Focused on accountability, consistency, and continuous improvement

title: Senior Automation Specialist, Fabrication and Weld
description:
About Blue Bird Corporation

Blue Bird (NASDAQ: BLBD) is recognized as a technology leader and innovator of school buses since its founding in 1927. Our dedicated team members design, engineer and manufacture school buses with a singular focus on safety, reliability, and durability. School buses carry the most precious cargo in the world – 25 million children twice a day – making them the most trusted mode of student transportation. The company is the proven leader in low- and zero-emission school buses with more than 25,000 propane, natural gas, and electric powered buses sold. Blue Bird is transforming the student transportation industry through cleaner energy solutions. For more information on Blue Bird’s complete product and service portfolio, visit .

JOB SUMMARY

The Senior Automation Specialist, Fabrication and Weld delivers and sustains automated manufacturing equipment and process capability across the equipment lifecycle. This role focuses on equipment performance, process robustness, and reliability to meet safety, quality, throughput, and cost objectives. The specialist leads equipment acceptance activities (FAT/SAT/Run-at-Rate), validates capability targets (e.g., Cp/Cpk, OEE, MTBF/MTTR), and partners with Operations, Maintenance, Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, and suppliers/integrators to implement scalable, maintainable automation solutions.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Equipment & Automation Systems

  • Design, specify, program, and commission automated manufacturing equipment, including:
    • PLC‑controlled systems
    • Robotics and motion systems
    • Vision inspection systems
    • Material handling and part tracking solutions
  • Develop, test, and maintain PLC control logic for automated manufacturing equipment (discrete, continuous, and motion applications).
  • Build and sustain HMI interfaces for machine control, diagnostics, alarms, and operator interaction.
  • Define and validate equipment capability (Cp/Cpk, OEE, MTBF, MTTR) to ensure systems meet production and quality requirements.
  • Lead equipment buy‑off activities, including FAT, SAT, and Run‑at‑Rate support.

    Robotics Programming & Integration

    • Develop and refine robot programs (online/offline) to support applications such as material handling, assembly, welding, dispensing, and palletizing.
    • Optimize robot motion and interactions for cycle time, repeatability, reliability, and safe recovery.
    • Integrate robots and vision systems with PLCs, safety circuits, and peripheral equipment, support commissioning and validation activities.

    Process & Manufacturing Capability

    • Translate product and process requirements into automation solutions that are repeatable, stable, scalable, and maintainable.
    • Develop and validate process windows and settings within automated equipment to ensure consistent output across shifts and lots.
    • Identify automation-driven risks and implement mitigation (poka-yoke, interlocks, detection/verification, alarms) to protect quality and safety.
    • Support continuous improvement initiatives targeting yield, cycle time, scrap reduction, and labor efficiency.

    Equipment Reliability & Sustainment

    • Support start‑up, ramp, and high‑volume production through hands‑on troubleshooting and optimization.
    • Partner with Maintenance to develop:
      • Preventive maintenance strategies
      • Spare parts lists
      • Technical documentation and training materials
    • Drive corrective actions for chronic equipment or process issues.
    • Support modifications and retrofits driven by process changes, cost reduction, or obsolescence.

    Cross‑Functional & Supplier Engagement

    • Collaborate with Product Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Operations, and Maintenance throughout equipment development and deployment.
    • Manage automation suppliers and integrators for technical scope definition, deliverables, timelines, and performance accountability (as assigned).
    • Support PFMEA/DFMEA contributions, control plan development, and quality audits related to automated processes.

    KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES FOR SUCCESS

    • Strong knowledge of welding processes and equipment (GMAW, SMAW, GTAW)
    • Experience in weld training and/or inspection
    • Working knowledge of automated equipment capability and manufacturing process control, including Cp/Cpk, OEE, MTBF, and MTTR.
    • Experience supporting or commissioning industrial robots (e.g., FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa) and integrating with equipment/process requirements.
    • Proficiency troubleshooting control systems and complex electromechanical systems in a production environment.
    • Experience integrating or supporting vision systems (e.g., Cognex, Keyence) and automated detection/verification strategies.
    • Working knowledge of functional safety concepts and applicable standards (ANSI/ISO/OSHA and internal safety requirements).
    • Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma principles; ability to apply structured problem-solving methods.
    • Strong systems-level thinking with focus on equipment-process interaction and sustainable countermeasures.
    • Clear technical communication with operators, engineers, maintenance teams, and suppliers/integrators; results-oriented mindset.

    BASIC EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

    • High School Diploma or GED required
    • 5+ years of experience in fabrication and welding
      • Industrial automation and programming within a manufacturing environment, preferred
    • AWS-CWI required or have the ability to obtain within 90 days of hire.
    • All candidates must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident

    PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

    • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Weld, Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Mechatronics, or related)

    WE VALUE

    • Ability to anticipate and understand customer needs and provide guidance
    • Excellent interpersonal and customer relationship skills to handle difficult and sensitive matters.
    • Strong project management skills. Exposure to difficult or complex projects a plus.
    • Ability to influence stakeholders
    • Effective communication and ability to communicate complex details in a clear manner.
    • Flexible workspaces and work hours that help you unleash the best you.
    • Working in a collaborative team and balancing the needs of individual stakeholders while delivering corporate objectives.

    INCLUDES

    • Continued Professional Development
    • Benefits including medical, dental and vision insurance, 14 paid holidays, vacation time and 401k matching

    WORK CONDITIONS

    The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

    • Manufacturing environment with exposure to heat, cold and noise
    • Must be able to work as necessary
    • Must be able to work with diverse workforce
    • Weekends and travel as required

    PERFORMANCE CRITERIA:

    • Able to meet engineering standards and procedures
    • Follow company policy and procedures
    • Successful project completion
    • Must meet established department goals
    • Must work within budgetary boundaries

    *The specific statements shown in each section of this description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria necessary to successfully perform the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

You will bridge complex clinical priorities and visionary scientific research, converting them into inspiring, high-impact donor opportunities that accelerate discoveries for neurodegenerative diseases, mental health, brain injury, and cognitive science.

Why This Role Is Unique

Power a World-Renowned Ecosystem: Drive philanthropic strategy across the prestigious UCSF Weill Institute for Neurosciences, unifying elite departments - including Neurology, Neurological Surgery, and Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences - alongside cutting-edge research centers.

  • Direct Access to Visionary Academic Leadership: Serve as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to department chairs, institute directors, and world-renowned scientists, translating complex clinical and basic science visions into compelling philanthropic narratives.
  • High-Impact, Transformative Philanthropy: Secure visionary gifts that directly accelerate clinical breakthroughs, expand patient access, fund high-risk/high-reward research, and empower the next generation of neuroscience leaders.

title: Data Conversion Analyst
description:
The first 90% of a data conversion is simple, but the remaining 10% is where the fun starts. That’s where you get to exercise your problem-solving skills. If the following describes you, you’re a perfect fit for the data conversion analyst role at Grant Street Group.

You want to work with a team of awesome project managers, business analysts, developers, and data analysts to migrate clients to our TaxSys software. At Grant Street, you will have the opportunity to be part of a project team of 2-3 developers and 2-3 data analysts (including yourself). You will prepare data for customer training, verification by customer subject matter experts, and of course TaxSys go-live.

You love analyzing data and solving puzzles. In this position, you will help reverse-engineer legacy tax data and write specs for conversion into TaxSys. Developers will implement them, and you’ll QA the results and refine the specs. You’ll track down bad customer data and figure out how it got that way.

You’re an excellent communicator. Communication, both written and verbal, is what you do. You’ll work on specs for developers, documentation status updates for management, and customer communications. You know your audience, and you adapt to their needs and technical level. You keep it brief and to the point.

You love working with people. As a data conversion analyst, you’ll be the face of Grant Street Group. You’ll guide clients as they verify their data in TaxSys. You’ll help them understand tradeoffs and make decisions – for example, between “more” and “cleaner” data. Clients consistently describe our conversions as the best vendor experience they’ve ever had, and you will be one of the key people making that happen.

Qualifications:

  • At least 1 year of experience in each of the following:
  • Working directly with customers
  • Experience with data mapping, specifications, and/or other deliverables for developers
  • Analyzing data using SQL tools
  • Experience with SQL
  • Outstanding planning and time management skills
  • Experience with ETL tool and/or dbVisualizer a plus
  • Willingness to travel about 15% annually for face-to-face meetings with clients and colleagues
  • Project management experience and desire to lead projects
Why consider Grant Street Group as part of your future?

We reward teamwork, professional excellence, and individual responsibility. Using the best collaboration tools available, we offer a technology-rich work environment that makes it possible for us to support on-site and telecommuting positions tailored to the needs of our employees. If you are passionate about your work and you want to be on a team of exceptional professionals, then maybe Grant Street is for you!

Position Summary:

The Surgical Coordinator plays a critical role in managing the scheduling, coordination, and communication of all surgical procedures. This position involves working closely with surgeons, patients, insurance companies, and other healthcare professionals to ensure smooth and efficient surgical operations, while maintaining optimal patient care. The Surgical Coordinator must possess strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills to ensure timely and effective surgical procedures.

Job Duties & Essential Functions:

Patient Coordination & Communication

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for patients, addressing inquiries related to surgical preparation.
  • Confirm surgery dates and provide patients with detailed pre-operative and post-operative instructions.
  • Arrange patient transportation for surgical procedures or related appointments when needed.
  • Address patient concerns and questions both before and after surgical procedures.

Surgical Scheduling & Documentation

  • Schedule surgeries and coordinate pre-operative and post-operative appointments, including those with ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) and surgeons.
  • Ensure all required pre-operative documentation—such as consent forms, medical history, and lab results—is collected, reviewed, and accurately documented.
  • Prepare surgical folders and gather all necessary paperwork to ensure completeness and accuracy prior to procedures.
  • Coordinate pre-operative testing and review medication lists to ensure alignment with surgical protocols.
  • Confirm all critical details related to surgical procedures, including scheduling, insurance verification, medical clearances, authorizations, and consent forms.
  • Update the surgical schedule regularly to reflect any changes or adjustments.

Insurance Verification & Financial Coordination

  • Communicate with insurance providers to verify coverage and obtain necessary authorizations for procedures.
  • Verify insurance coverage, collect co-pays and surgical fees, and reconcile patient balances.
  • Collaborate with the billing department to ensure accurate recording and processing of charges.

Interdepartmental Coordination & Equipment Readiness

  • Act as a liaison between surgeons, anesthesiologists, nursing staff, and other healthcare professionals to ensure all surgical requirements are fulfilled.
  • Ensure availability and proper functioning of all necessary surgical equipment and supplies.

Administrative Tasks & Professional Development

  • Maintain and manage patient records, ensuring accuracy and confidentiality.
  • Utilize MD Prospects to track and manage patient leads.
  • Monitor and respond to work emails and utilize shared tools like Google Drive to stay informed during the workday.
  • Actively participate in continuing education by attending relevant classes or webinars and staying current with industry best practices.
  • Maintain strict adherence to HIPAA regulations by safeguarding patient privacy and ensuring the confidentiality of all health information.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by the supervisor.

title: Architect V - Enterprise Information
description:
JOB SUMMARY

This position is responsible for the leadership, analysis, and design of the Enterprise Information Architecture for PODS supporting our extraordinary company growth projections and digital experiences vision. Plays an integral role in building a holistic view and roadmap of the Company’s technology strategy, processes, and information technology roadmap. Partners with both business and technology groups to ensure that the proposed technical solutions not only align with the Company’s overall objectives but also ensure that both groups enable and drive each other to meet the needs of the Company’s mission and vision. This position will require you to deliver IA blueprints and designs, in line with functional IA roadmaps. A core part of the role will also be to evangelize Information Architecture and the value and impact of good Information Architecture design and governance to both IT and business teams.

The candidate must be recognized as an expert in Enterprise Information Architecture, with a demonstrated track record of delivering the optimal design of data and information architectures to support business objectives. The candidate will possess the background, skills, and experience to independently initiate and coordinate teams in complex technology evaluations, proofs of concept, and prototyping exercises. The candidate will also show demonstrated success in designing and documenting data flows across the estate, designing data models for analytics/reporting, assessing the feasibility of data models, working with business data governance groups in establishing data standards (master, reference, structure), and working with solution architects on data integration and service architectures.

The candidate will have at least 12 years of experience working for a company or governmental agency with at least 300 employees (if private sector) or 500 employees (if governmental agency).

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Understand business drivers and business capabilities (future and current state), and determine corresponding architectural designs and change requirements to drive the organization's targeted business outcomes.
  • Establish and thoroughly document strategic standards for enterprise application architecture across diverse platforms and internal engineering and development teams.
  • Ability to partner and collaborate across both IT and business teams to inform on the best Information Architecture
  • Oversee mapping of enterprise information architecture models to package application models, to determine impact or assess suitability of vendor solutions to enterprise information architecture requirements.
  • Ensures the data and the information needs of the business are realized through an intentional information architecture.
  • Document the infrastructure architecture environment and procedures to ensure the infrastructure remains cost effective, efficient, and of high quality.
  • Blueprint Data Architecture, including multi-year transitions and recommendations to drive transformation and modernization
  • Re-Engineers and maintains an enterprise-wide view of the data across all business systems. Analyzes information requirements specified by the user community and designs the required data structures to support those requirements.
  • Champions efforts to improve business performance through enterprise information solutions and capabilities, such as master data management (MDM), metadata management, analytics, content management, data integration, and related information management or information infrastructure components.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS: Education & Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor degree in computer science, system analysis or a related study.

· Minimum of 12+ years of enterprise level in one or more of the following IT disciplines: data architecture, database design, business intelligence.

· 7+ years’ experience as a Data Architect

· An Enterprise Architecture framework qualification such as TOGAF or ZF is plus.

· Expert knowledge and hands-on experience with MDM, BI, data warehouse design and implementation techniques

· Knowledge of industry standard middleware, ETL, master data hub, and service oriented architecture, design and delivery solutions

· Eexperience of working with a range of BI & analytics architectures: including traditional warehousing, Distributed computing, NoSQL, virtualization or data streaming,

· Experience of defining Information Architectures for cloud-based solutions and technologies such as Azure Data Factory for ETL, Databricks, Azure Data Lake, Snowflake, Azure SQL, Cassandra & Cosmos.

· An understanding of the use and hands-on experience with ERWin for application (OLTP) and data warehouse (OLAP) data models and implementation, or industry standard modelling tool

· An understanding of domain modelling, business process data flows, business information modelling, entity flows diagrams, common information models, Master Data Management

· Knowledge of Microsoft Azure Stack

· Experience with Tableau, Power BI and Snowflake

· Knowledge of, and hands-on experience of implementing data management capabilities – including Master and Reference Data Management, Data Quality Management, Metadata Management and Data Governance.
