title: Soybean Processing Plant - Process Operator
description:
The Basics
Process Operator I is an entry-level role designed to introduce Team Members to the dynamic crush plant environment and learning to provide hands-on support to daily operations

Location: Cherryvale, KS
Compensation: $24/hr and up
Days/Hours: These operator will work a 12 hour shift in a ‘4 days on, 4 days off’ pattern. They will rotate between 7am-7pm and 7pm-7am every 2 months.
Equipment Used: Various equipment and machinery to move soybeans and extract and refine the oil
Material Handled: Bulk soybeans, soybean meal, soybean oil

These are just a few of the benefits you can expect from working with Bartlett:

Excellent benefits including medical, dental, vision, PTO, Holidays, Profit Sharing, and 401(k) with match
Uniforms provided
PPE provided by the company
Boot reimbursement
Cold weather clothing reimbursement
A culture of safety
Uniform Services Time Off (USTO)
Uniform Services Differential Pay
A culture that appreciates Team Members

What you’ll be doing:
The duties of this hands-on job will include cracking, heating and flaking soybeans to prepare it for extraction of the oil inside. Once the oil is extracted, it will be refined, depending on the intended end use of the product. This multi-step process will be done by operating state-of-the-art machinery. While many of these processes will be automated, each operator must be highly trained to monitor the process and make adjustments to ensure maximum yield. You are responsible for food safety.

Specific Job Duties:

Follow all safety policies and procedures, actively contributing to a strong safety culture.
Housekeeping duties which include sampling, equipment greasing duties
Knowledgeable and compliant with all GMP standards
Complete Operations Trainings which include sampling standards
Operate and monitor equipment and control systems in designated areas such as preparation, refinery, extraction, and grain drying.
Conduct routine sampling, input data into computer systems, and monitor processing to ensure accuracy and efficiency.
Complete training in all federal, state and local, food safety and health regulations
Inspect facility buildings, grounds, and equipment to identify issues, perform light maintenance, and complete minor repairs.
Collaborate with team members and supervisors to support continuous improvement and maintain a team-oriented work environment.
Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
Perform other duties assigned to support overall plant operation Process Operators will be cross trained to perform a variety of tasks.

Requirements to be successful in this position:

High school diploma or GED
Experience in a processing plant, refinery, mill, or elevator is preferred
Available to work off hours and weekends
For safety reasons, must be able to read, write, understand and follow written and/or verbal instructions in English
Professional demeanor (safety conscious, quality of job performance, cleanliness, and verbal communications)
Able to pass a criminal background check

Here are some of the physical requirements for this role:

This job can be physically strenuous
You will be expected to be able to work in tight and confined spaces
You will work at heights
You will need the ability to frequently lift, push and pull up to 50 pounds and occasionally more
This job will require the ability to ascend/descend ladders
You will be required to wear PPE

title: Masker I
location: Clear Lake, Village of, Wisconsin, United States
description:

· Maintain a neat and orderly work area.

· Adhere to plant and corporate safety policies.

High school diploma or general education degree (GED) required. May complete the SCS Reading Comprehension assessment in lieu of GED.

BASIC SKILLS:

· Must clearly speak, read and write English.

· Ability to comprehend written and verbal instructions, short correspondence and memos.

· Ability to communicate uncomplicated data, instructions, production results, quality issues and similar subjects both verbally and in writing.

· Ability to perform basic math functions.

· Ability to work in a seated position for extended periods of time.

· High degree of manual dexterity and eye-hand coordination in order to perform precision masking and demasking functions.

· Ability to distinguish between the colors of red, orange, yellow, blue, green and violet.

· Able to read at a 20/20 visual acuity using a Jaeger eye chart (near vision) with or without vision correction. Able to read No. 1 at 14” distance, or No. 2 at 20” distance, or No. 3 at 24” distance.

Must have the ability to multi-task and prioritize calls for service. Conflict resolution skills are a must. Must be adaptable and excel at problem solving with both guests and fellow staff members. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Follows established policies, procedures, and regulations, both Mesquite Gaming and Nevada State Gaming Control Board, to ensure proper compliance and for the protection of company assets and to provide a safe, secure, and productive environment for guests and co-workers.

Investigates complaints and violations of law and policies and prepares accurate, comprehensive written reports and statements, as necessary, to document such events and activities and may testify in court or other formal or informal proceedings.

Fosters and maintains positive working relationships with other departments and staff members to resolve customer issues and concerns.

Response to calls for service and uses radio and/or telephone communications to summon assistance from other security officers, personnel from other Company departments, police, fire, or emergency medical services as the situation dictates.

Provides escorts for the safety of customers and other Company personnel, protecting them and the valuables they may have in their possession, and making buys and fills for other departments.

Is a first-responder in any medical situation and provides first aid until further qualified medical assistance arrives.

Other job-related duties as assigned and instructed by management.

Be courteous, respectful, and approachable, greeting customers and co-workers with a smile and exhibit a friendly, positive attitude, making them feel welcome and important to you.

Communicate and coordinate with other departments and players to assess customer needs and to ensure that quality service is provided to the customer and evaluate customer satisfaction.

Be informed and promptly follow through with what needs to be done exceeding our guests’ expectations.

The work requires some physical exertion such as long periods of standing, walking on uneven surfaces, lifting moderately heavy objects. The work may require above average strength, agility, or dexterity.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:
The work environment may occasionally involve exposure to potentially dangerous situations or unusual environmental stress requiring a range of safety and other precautions, i.e., extreme outdoor weather conditions, under threat of a physical attack by another person, mob condition, or in similar situations in which conditions cannot be completely controlled. The work environment involves exposure to secondhand smoke in a casino.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
About the role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable services that real clinical workflows depend on. You'll design and own backend systems, APIs, and the event-driven infrastructure that connects them.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can take a service from technical design to production, make pragmatic decisions, and collaborate effectively with product and engineering teams.

You'll work with modern JVM technologies, AWS, and event-driven systems in a healthcare technology environment where reliability, data integrity, and delivery matter.

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and own JVM backend services (Java, Kotlin, or Scala) from technical design through production.
  • Build reliable service-to-service communication with gRPC: well-defined contracts, deadlines and timeouts, retries with backoff, idempotent operations, and graceful degradation when a dependency fails.
  • Design public and internal APIs (REST, GraphQL)
  • Build event-driven and asynchronous workflows that stay consistent under failure, using patterns such as idempotent consumers, dead-letter handling, Saga, and Transactional Outbox.
  • Own the infrastructure your services run on: define and evolve it with Terraform, review infrastructure changes like application code, and ship through automated CI/CD pipelines.
  • Make services observable with metrics, structured logging, distributed tracing, and alerting tied to service-level objectives.
  • Model data and tune queries in relational databases so performance stays predictable as data grows.
  • Handle sensitive healthcare data responsibly through access control, encryption, and audit trails.
  • Write maintainable, well-tested code, lead technical design discussions, and help raise the bar through reviews and mentoring.
  • Use AI effectively to improve development workflows, from exploration and implementation to testing, debugging, and documentation.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams to deliver features on time.

Qualifications

  • Strong professional experience building and operating backend systems in production.
  • Solid experience with the JVM ecosystem: Java, Kotlin, or Scala.
  • Hands-on experience with gRPC or a similar RPC framework for service-to-service communication, including timeouts, retries, and failure handling.
  • Experience designing production-grade APIs with REST and GraphQL.
  • Experience with event-driven architecture and message queues, and with the delivery and consistency challenges that come with them.
  • Solid relational database experience: schema design, indexing, and query performance.
  • Hands-on experience managing cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) with Terraform.
  • Experience running services in production: observability, incident response, and root-cause analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a pragmatic approach to engineering decisions.
  • Ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and take ownership of deliverables.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, both written and verbal.
  • A strong interest in using AI efficiently and responsibly in software development.

    Nice to have
  • Experience in healthcare technology or other highly regulated industries.
  • Experience with healthcare data standards such as HL7 or FHIR.
  • Experience with resilience patterns such as circuit breakers, bulkheads, and rate limiting.
  • Experience with stream processing or change data capture.
  • Experience with containers and container orchestration.
  • Some frontend familiarity to collaborate smoothly across the stack.
  • Experience contributing to technical architecture and mentoring other engineers.


What we offer

  • Remote-first, full-time, permanent employment in Türkiye.
  • Salary paid in USD, net.
  • Payroll employment with the benefits of a permanent position.
  • Access to our office at ODTÜ Teknokent, Ankara, with regular visits according to planned schedules.
  • 100% private health insurance coverage for the employee.
  • 50% private health insurance coverage for eligible family members, if you choose to include them.
  • Floating vacation days: when a public holiday falls on a weekend, you can take the corresponding day off on a weekday of your choice, subject to applicable policies.
  • The opportunity to work on meaningful healthcare technology products with a collaborative engineering team.
  • A culture that values ownership, continuous learning, and delivering high-quality software.

title: AI Enablement Lead
description:
About the role


We're looking for an AI Enablement Lead to turn Atmosphere's existing AI tooling into workflows that give our internal teams back time for creative problem-solving, client relationships, and strategy. Our product and engineering team already builds with AI every day; this role brings that foundation to the rest of the company.


You'll sit side-by-side with internal teams, map how their work actually flows, find where it slows down, and build tools that fix it, whether that's a custom AI skill, an automated assistant, or an integration. You'll build, test, and refine alongside the people who use the tools. You'll start with our ad sales team, then bring what you learn to other departments.


This role is equal parts team advocate, systems builder, and practical coach. You'll need the empathy to understand user pain points, the judgment to tell whether a problem needs better process design or a new tool, and the hands-on technical skills to build solutions people actually want to use.


This position reports to the Chief Product & Technology Officer and is on-site in Austin, TX. In-office availability 4–5 days a week is required.


What you'll do

  • Embed with internal teams to map their workflows end to end, find the bottlenecks, and tackle the highest-impact problems first.
  • Tie every build to a measurable business outcome, such as lower cost-per-revenue or faster sales outreach, and work backward from that metric.
  • Design and build agentic workflows on our Claude plugins, connectors, and Salesforce stack, pairing live with users to solve problems in the moment rather than through a ticket queue.
  • Build tools that fit into the way people already work, and provide one-on-one coaching where a tool alone isn't enough.
  • Capture team inputs alongside final approved work and use that data to refine prompts, rules, and tool behavior over time.
  • Partner with engineering to decide what belongs in shared core architecture versus team-specific tooling, keeping our tech stack clean and unified.
  • Advise teams across departments on complex operational problems, including whether the right fix is better process, new software, or AI.
  • Document experiments, results, and reusable patterns so each new team rollout moves faster than the last.


Qualifications

  • A track record of shipping AI workflows that non-technical users adopted, and the ability to explain what didn't get used and why
  • Working understanding of agent loops, including how to design skills and tools and connect them to external APIs
  • Hands-on experience with current AI tooling (Claude skills, plugins, MCP, or similar)
  • Enough Python or TypeScript to build integrations yourself
  • Product instincts: you frame the problem, pick the metric, prioritize hard, and stay on one bottleneck as long as the leverage is there
  • Experience improving operational processes, or a demonstrated knack for untangling messy workflows
  • Strong people skills, including the ability to bring busy, skeptical users along rather than running past them
  • Clear writing across specs, prompts, and write-ups
  • A bias toward simplicity and toward tools that disappear into the work


Nice to Haves:

  • Operational exposure to sales teams
  • Salesforce or Gong automation experience
  • Experience building evaluation or feedback tooling for LLM outputs
  • Background as a founder, early employee, forward-deployed engineer, or GTM engineer
  • Experience with programmatic document generation (python-pptx or similar)


Compensation & Benefits:

  • Competitive salary
  • Company Equity
  • Company 401(k) with employer matching
  • Competitive insurance plans
  • Flexible Time Off Policy

title: Vice President, Revenue Cycle Management
description:
Vice President, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)

A career that changes lives.

SightMD is a rapidly growing integrated ophthalmic provider group, extending the reach of exceptional eye care to patients across New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Connecticut, and Massachusetts. With over 127 eye care providers and the convenience of 60 locations, our commitment to delivering unparalleled services is at the heart of everything we do. As we embark on our mission, we are actively seeking teammates who are eager to contribute to our legacy of eye excellence, a tradition that spans more than 50 years.

Position Summary: The Vice President of Revenue Cycle Management (VP, RCM) is responsible for the organization’s end-to-end revenue cycle performance, including maximizing collections, reducing revenue leakage, improving A/R, and ensuring accurate and timely reimbursement across clinical, surgical, optical, and cash-pay services. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the VP oversees revenue cycle operations, payer and provider credentialing, revenue integrity, and payer strategy. This role is responsible for improving performance across the platform, standardizing processes, reducing aged A/R, and successfully integrating acquired and new practices.

Job Duties & Essential Functions:

  • Revenue Cycle Leadership: Lead end-to-end RCM operations across all locations and entities, including patient access, eligibility, authorization, charge capture, coding, billing, collections, payment posting, denials, appeals, and A/R. Build and develop a high-performing team and establish standardized processes and performance expectations.
  • A/R & Revenue Performance: Drive improvements in net collection rate, days in A/R, aged A/R, cash collections, denials, underpayments, credit balances, and refunds. Establish measurable recovery plans and identify and eliminate revenue leakage.
  • Payer Strategy & Contracting: Partner with the CFO on payer strategy and negotiations. Maintain payer performance analytics, model reimbursement and contract terms, support negotiations, and ensure contracted rates and terms are accurately implemented and enforced.
  • Credentialing & Revenue Integrity: Oversee payer/provider credentialing and enrollment, including multi-state enrollment, recredentialing, revalidation, CAQH, licensing, and expirables. Lead revenue integrity, including charge capture, charge master and fee schedule governance, coding accuracy, documentation, and coding audits.
  • Ophthalmology & ASC Revenue: Ensure accurate billing and reimbursement for ophthalmology and ASC services, including surgical procedures, global periods, modifiers, co-management, diagnostic testing, and buy-and-bill pharmaceuticals. Oversee optical, vision plan, elective, and cash-pay revenue processes.
  • M&A, Technology & Process Improvement: Lead RCM diligence and integration for acquisitions, de novo locations, and PM/EHR conversions. Own the RCM technology and automation strategy and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce cost to collect, and accelerate cash.
  • Analytics, Compliance & Executive Reporting: Provide weekly and monthly RCM reporting, forecasting, payer analytics, and A/R reporting. Partner with Finance, Compliance, Legal, IT, and operational leadership to ensure regulatory compliance, financial accuracy, and effective risk management. Present performance and recommendations to executive leadership, the Board, lenders, and investors.

    Required Qualifications:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Healthcare Administration, Business, or related field.
    • 10+ years of progressive revenue cycle experience, including 5+ years in a senior/executive leadership role.
    • Experience leading RCM for a multi-site physician group or health system with $150M+ in annual net patient service revenue.
    • Demonstrated success improving A/R, collections, denials, reimbursement, and other key RCM metrics.
    • Strong knowledge of professional billing, payer reimbursement, CPT/HCPCS/ICD-10 coding, revenue integrity, and government and commercial payer requirements.
    • Experience with payer/provider credentialing and enrollment, payer contracting, and negotiations.
    • Experience leading RCM integration for acquisitions and PM/EHR conversions.
    • Experience managing large teams and outsourced/offshore RCM partners.
    • Strong analytical, financial, communication, and executive presentation skills.
    • Ability to work in a hybrid role with regular onsite presence in Hauppauge, NY.

    Preferred Qualifications:

    • MBA, MHA, or equivalent advanced degree.
    • Ophthalmology, ASC, or surgical subspecialty revenue cycle experience.
    • Experience with buy-and-bill pharmaceuticals and optical/vision plan revenue.
    • Experience in a private equity-backed MSO or physician platform.
    • Multi-state experience, preferably NY, NJ, PA, MA or CT.
    • Experience with ophthalmology PM/EHR, ASC billing, credentialing, and contract management systems.
    • Relevant revenue cycle, coding, or ophthalmology certification.

    Work Schedule:

    • Monday - Friday
    • Hybrid work environment
    • Ability to work in a hybrid role with regular onsite presence in Hauppauge, NY.

    Salary Range:

    • $190,000 – $220,000 annually, commensurate with experience.

    We aim to take care of our teammates the same way we take care of our patients.

    • Company Paid Term Life Insurance & Long-Term Disability

title: Wind Technician Level 1,2, or 3
description:
Wind Technician Level 1,2, or 3

Job Type: Non-Exempt, Hourly

Location: United States – Onsite – Bull Hill Ste – Franklin, Maine

Reports to: Manager, Operations & Maintenance

Department: Wind Operations - Wind Turbines

Requisition ID: WINDT005891

Cost Center: ​Operations BPAM82 - 2362-TERP Wind Bull Hill

ABOUT TERRAFORM POWER

TerraForm Power is a leading owner, operator, and producer of renewable energy across North America. As a portfolio company of Brookfield Renewable, we own and operate approximately 2,200 MW of utility-scale wind, solar, and battery energy storage facilities across 15 U.S. states and Ontario, Canada.

Headquartered in New York City, TerraForm Power is committed to delivering reliable, innovative renewable energy solutions that help customers achieve their clean energy goals. Our experienced team manages every aspect of our operations – from power generation and asset management to commercial energy solutions – ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient performance of our renewable energy facilities.

At TerraForm Power, our people are at the heart of our success. We foster a culture built on safety, integrity, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement, while investing in the development of our employees and supporting the communities where we operate through environmental stewardship, charitable giving, and meaningful local partnerships. If you're passionate about renewable energy and want to make a lasting impact on the future of clean power, we invite you to join our team.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Wind Technician is responsible for the safe operation, inspection, preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and optimization of utility-scale wind turbines, Balance of Plant (BOP) equipment, and associated electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and control systems. The position supports safe, reliable, and efficient plant operations while ensuring compliance with all Health, Safety, Security & Environmental (HSSE) requirements.

This position may be filled at the Wind Technician Level 1, Level 2, or Level 3 based on the successful candidate's education, certifications, technical knowledge, demonstrated competencies, and relevant work experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform preventative, predictive, and corrective maintenance on wind turbines and Balance of Plant equipment.
  • Inspect, troubleshoot, repair, and replace mechanical, hydraulic, electrical, and PLC components.
  • Diagnose equipment issues using SCADA systems, diagnostic tools, and technical documentation.
  • Complete maintenance documentation using computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS).
  • Perform equipment inspections and identify opportunities to improve equipment reliability.
  • Assist with medium- and high-voltage switching activities after receiving required qualifications.
  • Support maintenance and troubleshooting of substation and Balance of Plant equipment.
  • Maintain inventory records and assist with parts management.
  • Operate company vehicles, tools, and specialized equipment safely.
  • Follow all Health, Safety, Security & Environmental (HSSE) policies and procedures.
  • Participate in rotating on-call coverage and emergency response activities.
  • Travel between TerraForm Power's facilities as operational needs require.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.
  • Travel to support other TerraForm sites when required.

Additional responsibilities for higher technician levels may include:

  • Performing advanced diagnostics and complex troubleshooting.
  • Leading major component replacements and outage activities.
  • Monitoring contractor work.
  • Mentoring and training less experienced technicians.
  • Recommending improvements to maintenance procedures and equipment reliability.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Valid driver's license with acceptable driving record.
  • Ability to climb wind turbines of approximately 90 meters.
  • Ability to work at heights and outdoors in varying weather conditions.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds independently.
  • Experience troubleshooting Vestas V110 1.8 MW MK7 turbines preferred
  • Basic computer proficiency and ability to utilize computerized maintenance management systems.

title: EJ Community Advocate
description:
Who We Are

COPAL, Communities Organizing Latine Power and Action, is a member-based organization established in 2018 to improve the quality of life of Latine families. Grounded in the Principles of Jemez, COPAL is committed to continue building meaningful relationships that transcend both identity and geographical boundaries. COPAL envisions a Minnesota where everyone lives with dignity and respect.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Our greatest asset is the dedication and commitment of our board, staff, members, and interns, as well as our valued volunteers, partners, coalition members, and leaders of the Latine community. With a clear mission and vision of a better future for all, we can mobilize people to bring about transformation and lead social, political, and economic change.

Wages

$26.00 - $28.00 per hour depending on qualifications and level of experience

Benefits

  • Earned Sick and Safe Time (ESST)
  • COPAL sponsors a retirement plan with 6% employer contribution after 90 days of service and immediate vesting

Because COPAL is a member with Metropolitan Alliance of Connected Communities (MACC) who partners with St. Mary’s University, COPAL employees and their spouses are also eligible for the following benefits at St. Mary’s University:

  • Discounted tuition for Bachelor’s, Master’s, and Doctorate programs
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Access to advancement (internships, job placement, field practice)

Schedule

This is a temporary, full-time position that will work fully in-person. This position will require some travel throughout Minnesota and availability on occasional evenings and weekends as required by community meetings, public hearings, legislative activities, and other responsibilities.

Job Summary

COPAL is hiring a EJ Community Advocate to serve as a bridge between community members and the legislative, regulatory, and public decision-making processes that shape environmental conditions in Minnesota. The position supports meaningful community participation in Environmental Justice (EJ) advocacy while advancing key departmental priorities, including Just Energy Transition, Cumulative Impacts & Environmental Health, and Green Jobs & Workforce Justice.

Responsibilities

  • Build trusted relationships with Latine, immigrant, BIPOC, and historically underserved communities and support meaningful participation in environmental decision-making processes.
  • Build community members’ capacity to navigate and meaningfully participate in advocacy, legislative, and regulatory processes, including providing testimony, submitting public comments, and communicating their lived experiences and priorities to decision-makers.
  • Participate in relevant legislative, regulatory, agency, coalition, and public engagement processes in coordination with the Environmental Justice Policy Advocate.
  • Translate complex environmental policy, regulatory, scientific, and technical information into accessible and culturally relevant information for community audiences.
  • Facilitate community conversations, listening sessions, advocacy workshops, and educational activities related to COPAL’s Environmental Justice priorities.
  • Support community participation in key environmental justice priorities, including Just Energy Transition, Cumulative Impacts & Environmental Health, climate resilience, and other emerging environmental issues.
  • Lead or coordinate assigned Green Jobs & Workforce Justice initiatives, connecting community members with workforce training, career pathways, educational opportunities, and relevant resources.
  • Serve as a liaison among community members, COPAL, public agencies, coalition partners, and other stakeholders to strengthen meaningful community participation and ensure advocacy efforts remain informed by community priorities and lived experiences.
  • Track community participation, advocacy activities, outcomes, and qualitative impact information needed for departmental planning, evaluation, grants, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with the Environmental Justice team and other COPAL departments to advance shared departmental and organizational priorities.

What You Bring

  • A bachelor’s degree in environmental studies, public policy, political science, sociology, community development, social justice, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
  • A minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in community advocacy, public engagement, environmental justice, civic participation, policy-related community work, or a related field.
  • Being bilingual in Spanish and English is required.
  • Previous experience working with Latine, immigrant, BIPOC, or historically underserved communities is strongly preferred.
  • Previous experience with or demonstrated skills in engaging with legislative, regulatory, governmental, coalition, or public decision-making processes is preferred.
  • A strong commitment to environmental justice, social equity, community voice, and meaningful public participation.
  • The ability to understand environmental policy, regulatory, scientific, or technical information and communicate it clearly and accessibly to community audiences.
  • Strong relationship-building, facilitation, interpersonal communication, and community engagement skills.
  • The ability to support community members in developing and communicating their own perspectives and priorities within advocacy and decision-making spaces.
  • An understanding of culturally responsive and language-accessible community engagement.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain accurate documentation, and contribute to reporting and evaluation.
  • The ability to collaborate effectively with community members, policy staff, public agencies, coalition partners, educational institutions, workforce organizations, and other stakeholders.
  • The ability to travel throughout Minnesota and work occasional evenings and weekends as required by community meetings, public hearings, legislative activities, and other responsibilities.
  • A valid driver’s license, access to reliable transportation, and the ability to meet COPAL’s driving record requirements. Please note that if the license was not issued in the state of Minnesota, you have 60 days after becoming a Minnesota resident in which to apply for your Minnesota driver's license or permit.

Please go to COPAL’s Job Board to apply through our online applicant tracking system.

Diversity and open expression are fundamental to the work of COPAL. We are passionate about building and sustaining an inclusive and equitable working environment where everyone can belong. Every member of our team enriches our work by exposing us to a broad range of ways to understand and engage with the world, identify challenges, and to discover, design, and deliver solutions. We welcome everyone to apply, especially those individuals who are underrepresented in our sector: individuals who identify as BIPOC, Indigenous or people of culture, LGBTQI+ and gender fluid or gender nonconforming, individuals with disabilities (both seen and unseen), veterans, people of any age or family status. We encourage you to apply even if you feel like you don't fit 100% of the technical requirements. Equal Opportunity Employer: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, ancestry, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, familial status, disability, age, marital status, membership or activity in a local human rights commission, status with regard to public assistance, criminal history (justice-impacted status), housing or homelessness status, height, or weight.

title: Senior Data Engineer (India)
description:
The Lead Data Engineer will design, build, and operationalize scalable data solutions to support enterprise analytics and AI/ML initiatives. This role requires expert-level proficiency in Databricks, Azure Fabric, PySpark, SQL, and the Azure ecosystem, with deep experience across data warehouses, data lakes, and real-time integration. The Lead Data Engineer will architect end-to-end pipelines using industry-standard tools, drive automation, and move solutions effectively into production. The incumbent will ensure compliance with data governance requirements (including GxP and HIPAA/GDPR) while building reusable, integrated pipelines and analytical models that promote self-service analytics. This role provides technical leadership across the team, mentors junior engineers, and partners with business stakeholders to align data engineering with organizational objectives.

About the Role

  • Architect, design, and implement end-to-end data solutions using Azure Databricks, PySpark, Azure Data Factory, and Azure SQL.
  • Design, build, and maintain data pipelines from data sources through integration to consumption for specific use cases.
  • Implement robust data modeling standards across bronze, silver, and gold layers in the data lake.
  • Develop data models (conceptual, logical, and/or physical) as required.
  • Optimize Spark and SQL workloads for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Manage metadata using data preparation, integration, and AI-enabled tools and techniques.

About You

Job Experience & Education Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred)

5–8 years of experience designing and developing enterprise-scale data solutions (data warehouses, data lakes, operational databases)

  • Expert-level proficiency in Databricks, Azure Fabric, PySpark, SQL, and Azure DevOps.
  • Proven experience with Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, and Azure SQL Server.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Azure data management architectures including Data Warehouse, Data Lake, and Data Catalogue, and supporting processes such as Data Integration, Governance, and Metadata Management.
  • Experience with Power BI required; Tableau or Looker a plus.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD automation, version control (Git), and infrastructure as code (ARM, Bicep, or Terraform).
  • Experience in life sciences or healthcare industries is a strong plus.
  • Good understanding of GxP, GDPR/HIPAA, and applicable CFR/CTR/CTD regulations.

description:
Invoice Processing Specialist

Job Type: Full-time
Work Setup: Remote
Schedule: Full-time; must have availability to overlap with U.S. Eastern Time (EST) business hours

Apply here:

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Invoice Processing Specialist to manage and verify invoices associated with medical records requests.

In this role, you will review incoming invoices, match them to the appropriate requests, verify amounts and payment requirements, process payments, and resolve discrepancies or disputes. The position requires strong numerical accuracy, attention to detail, and the ability to identify potential duplicate or fraudulent payment requests.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the Invoice Queue: Review and process incoming invoices daily, prioritizing overdue items and time-sensitive requests.
  • Match and Verify Invoices: Confirm patient, provider, record type, invoice details, and payment amounts before processing.
  • Identify Duplicates: Review potential duplicate or near-match invoices and verify whether they represent legitimate charges before payment.
  • Apply Payment Limits and Requirements: Process payments within approved limits and route amounts exceeding authorized limits for the appropriate approval.
  • Review Fees: Identify potentially incorrect or disallowed fees and initiate the appropriate dispute or escalation process.
  • Process Payments: Make payments through credit card, online provider portals, prepayment systems, mailed checks, or other approved methods.
  • Resolve Payment Disputes: Follow up on duplicate charges, incorrect fees, refunds, or other payment issues and maintain clear documentation of each resolution.
  • Maintain Payment Records: Keep accurate records of invoices, payments, disputes, approvals, and related communications.
  • Verify Payment Information: Follow established procedures to verify changes to vendor payment details using trusted contact information before processing payments.
  • Follow Internal Procedures: Ensure all payments and invoice-processing activities follow established approval, documentation, and security procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Excellent written English with the ability to create clear and concise notes.
  • Experience reviewing invoices, payment information, or financial records.
  • Strong ability to identify discrepancies and potential duplicates.
  • Good organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work accurately in a high-volume environment.
  • Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to work independently and follow established procedures.
  • Ability to work a schedule that overlaps with U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Skills Assessment

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a timed skills assessment independently and without the use of AI tools.

The assessment may evaluate:

  • Duplicate invoice detection

  • Accuracy when reviewing amounts, dates, and invoice information
  • Navigating online invoice and payment portals
  • Understanding payment approval requirements
  • Fraud awareness and payment verification
  • Handling payment disputes and refunds
  • Accuracy, judgment, and attention to detail

Preferred Experience

Experience in any of the following areas is an advantage:

  • Accounts payable
  • Invoice processing
  • Vendor payments
  • High-volume payment processing
  • Healthcare billing or revenue cycle operations
  • Payment reconciliation
  • Payment disputes and refunds
  • Excel or Google Sheets
  • Medical records or healthcare information processes
  • Experience using healthcare or records-related vendor portals

Key Skills

  • Invoice processing
  • Accounts payable
  • Payment verification
  • Data and numerical accuracy
  • Duplicate detection
  • Reconciliation
  • Payment dispute resolution
  • Fraud awareness
  • Spreadsheet management
  • Attention to detail
  • Organization and follow-through
  • Written communication

What We Offer

  • Full-time remote work
  • Opportunity to develop experience in invoice processing and healthcare-related operations
  • Opportunities for advancement into senior processing, finance operations, quality, or team leadership roles
  • A collaborative, fast-paced work environment focused on accuracy, integrity, and continuous improvement

description:
Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Its suite of products — including the Greenlight app, debit card, Safe Family GPS trackers, and Family Hub — brings together financial tools, safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience. Designed for busy families who want convenience without compromise, Greenlight continues to innovate alongside the evolving needs of modern life. Today, more than 6.5 million family members trust Greenlight to stay in sync.

At Greenlight, we're here to make the day-to-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. That's why we get out of bed every morning.

We are looking for a Brand Designer with a passion for creative storytelling and experience working within a design system on a wide range of activations. In this role, you will partner closely with the Design team to build and grow Greenlight’s visual brand identity across all of our marketing, advertising, and product touchpoints. You’ll be responsible for creating work that connects with families, clearly communicates all our product offerings, brings surprise & delight, and differentiates Greenlight in the competitor space.

Your day-to-day:

  • Concept and design engaging visual assets across Greenlight’s brand and product ecosystem to support customer acquisition, engagement, and retention efforts.
  • Work on a range of creative projects like marketing and product launch campaigns, website landing pages, emails, social media content, in-app content, company swag, presentation decks, direct mailers, and more.
  • Leverage motion to engage viewers and support storytelling.
  • Drive consistency and cohesion across the brand, building upon guidelines and identifying opportunities for fresh visual expression.
  • Collaborate with marketing and product managers, creative directors, strategists, copywriters, designers, and cross-functional teams to ensure your work delivers on the creative brief and meets business objectives.

What you’ll bring to the team:

  • 1-3 years of design experience at a creative agency or in-house at a design-led company.
  • A dynamic portfolio showcasing diverse design skills: layout, typography, color, form, motion, storytelling, and brand systems.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to work within brand guidelines
  • Strong visual and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment
  • A strong grasp on contemporary design aesthetics, trends, and interest in emerging technologies.
  • Advanced design skills in Figma. Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign). Working knowledge of AfterEffects is a big plus.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Nice to have: ability to design for print and create press-ready mechanical files

Not sure this one’s for you? Don’t count yourself out. Show us what you’ve got and we’ll reach out if there’s a great fit.

Our stance on salaries:

Greenlight provides a competitive compensation package with a market-based approach to pay and will vary depending on your location, experience and skill set. The total compensation package for this position will also include a discretionary performance bonus, equity rewards, medical benefits, 401K match, and more. Greenlight conducts continuous compensation evaluations across departments and geographies to ensure we are keeping our pay current and competitive.The estimated base pay range for this position in (NY, CA, WA): $85,000- 110,000
The estimated base pay range for this position in (CO): $85,000 - 100,000Who we are:It takes a talented team to aim for a mission like ours. We're looking for people who ask "is it bold enough?" People who bring their real selves to the table and push the people around them to do the same. We win by never hesitating to jump in, offer a hand, or share the credit, because we know we're stronger together than apart. And through all of it, the mission stays the thing we measure ourselves against: are we doing right by the families counting on us? If that sounds like your kind of team, we'd love for you to apply.Greenlight is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on age, race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including pregnancy, childbirth, or a medical condition related to pregnancy or childbirth), genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.Greenlight is committed to an inclusive work environment and interview experience. If you require reasonable accommodations to participate in our hiring process, please reach out to your recruiter directly or email [email protected].

title: Vice President, Utility Partnerships
description:
About the Role:

Aalo Atomics is seeking a Vice President of Utility Partnerships to lead engagement with electric utilities, municipal utilities, electric cooperatives, public power organizations, and other strategic energy partners as we deploy the next generation of advanced nuclear technology.


This executive-level role will be responsible for developing and expanding relationships across the utility sector, identifying opportunities for future reactor deployments, and creating partnerships that support the growth of Aalo's microreactor fleet. The successful candidate will understand how utilities evaluate generation resources, plan for long-term capacity needs, and invest in critical energy infrastructure.


As a key member of Aalo's leadership team, you will help shape the company's commercial growth strategy and establish Aalo as a trusted partner for utilities seeking reliable, dispatchable, carbon-free power. This position is ideally suited for an individual with significant experience in electric utilities, power generation, resource planning, or utility business development, along with a strong interest in the future of nuclear energy and advanced reactor technologies.


What You'll Do

  • Develop and execute Aalo's utility partnership strategy across investor-owned utilities, municipal utilities, electric cooperatives, public power agencies, and generation and transmission organizations.
  • Build and maintain senior-level relationships with utility executives, resource planning leaders, generation executives, and boards of directors.
  • Identify and advance opportunities for future deployment of Aalo microreactors and advanced nuclear energy systems.
  • Establish strategic partnerships, memorandums of understanding, and commercial frameworks with utilities exploring advanced nuclear generation.
  • Collaborate with utilities to evaluate potential sites and deployment opportunities, including retiring fossil generation facilities, utility-owned assets, industrial locations, and new development sites.
  • Support utility customers as they evaluate advanced nuclear technologies within long-term resource planning and clean energy strategies.
  • Develop commercial value propositions that align Aalo's technology with utility objectives related to reliability, resilience, affordability, energy security, and carbon reduction.
  • Serve as Aalo's primary interface with utility associations, public power organizations, cooperative organizations, and other industry stakeholders.
  • Monitor utility planning activities, generation trends, market developments, and emerging opportunities for advanced nuclear deployment.
  • Represent Aalo Atomics at utility conferences, industry meetings, public power events, and executive forums.
  • Work closely with internal development, engineering, and executive teams to align partnership opportunities with deployment priorities.
  • Help build and maintain a robust pipeline of utility-supported projects that will accelerate commercialization of Aalo's technology.


Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in the electric utility, power generation, energy infrastructure, or energy development sectors.
  • Demonstrated success building strategic relationships and partnerships within the utility industry.
  • Direct experience working with investor-owned utilities, municipal utilities, electric cooperatives, public power agencies, or generation and transmission organizations.
  • Strong understanding of utility resource planning, generation portfolios, capacity needs, and long-term infrastructure investment decisions.
  • Experience in power generation, including familiarity with baseload generation technologies such as nuclear, natural gas, coal, hydroelectric, or other dispatchable resources.
  • Understanding of advanced nuclear technologies, including small modular reactors (SMRs), microreactors, or the evolving role of nuclear energy in meeting future power demand.
  • Proven ability to engage and influence senior utility executives, elected boards, and key industry stakeholders.
  • Experience negotiating strategic partnerships, commercial agreements, or long-term energy development initiatives.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.
  • Strong strategic thinking and business development capabilities.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Energy Systems, Economics, Public Policy, or a related field.
  • Advanced degree preferred.


Requirements

  • Based in the United States.
  • Willing to work on-site in Austin, Texas or remote.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% for utility meetings, executive engagement, conferences, and site visits.
  • Applicants must be U.S. Citizens or U.S. Persons in compliance with 10 CFR Part 810 and may not hold non-compliant foreign citizenships.


What Success Looks Like

In this role, success will be measured by the ability to:

  • Establish Aalo as a trusted strategic partner to utilities evaluating advanced nuclear generation.
  • Develop and maintain executive-level relationships across the utility industry.
  • Create a robust pipeline of utility-supported deployment opportunities.
  • Secure strategic partnership agreements with utilities, municipal systems, and electric cooperatives.
  • Position Aalo's microreactor technology within utility long-term planning efforts and future generation portfolios.
  • Accelerate the commercialization and deployment of advanced nuclear energy across North America.


Requirements:

  • Based in the United States
  • Willing to work on-site in Austin, TX


What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary based on technical level
  • Health, Dental, Vision Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Corporate Gym Membership


Additional Information:

Aalo Atomics provides a collaborative and supportive work environment, opportunities for professional growth, intellectually challenging careers, and competitive compensation. Aalo Atomics is an equal opportunity employer and considers all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Applicants must be U.S. Citizens or U.S. Persons in compliance with 10 CFR Part 810 and may not hold non-compliant foreign citizenships.

Direct applicants only. No recruiters or staffing agencies, please.

title: Associate, Strategic Finance
description:
What We Need
Corpay is currently looking to hire an Associate, Strategic Finance. This position falls under our corporate line of business and is located in our Atlanta, GA global headquarters. In this role, you will serve as a key partner to executive leadership, supporting consolidated financial planning, analysis, and strategic decision-making across the enterprise. You will play a critical role in revenue and P&L reporting, forecasting, and executive-level deliverables, while also providing analytical support for strategic initiatives.

The ideal candidate brings strong analytical rigor, intellectual curiosity, and business acumen, combined with the ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels. This role is designed for a high-potential finance professional seeking significant exposure and growth into leadership roles within Finance. Prior experience in M&A, private equity, corporate development, transaction diligence, or strategy consulting is a plus.
How We Work
As an Associate Strategic Finance, you will be expected to work in an in-office environment.

Corpay will set you up for success by providing:

Assigned workspace in Atlanta, GA
Company-issued equipment
Hands-on training

Role Responsibilities

Driving monthly and quarterly consolidated revenue and P&L analysis, including telling the financial story, providing insights for executive leadership, and preparing monthly executive staff meeting materials
Preparing quarterly executive reporting materials, including consolidated forecasts, board presentations, earnings support, and guidance materials
Creating models and executive outputs for annual budget and long-range planning processes, including consolidation, scenario analysis, and executive presentations
Developing new financial models and reporting tools
Partnering across finance and functional teams to drive alignment, process improvement, and insights
Supporting ad hoc executive requests, M&A requests, and strategic projects
Identifying opportunities for process improvement, automation, and use of AI-driven tools to enhance reporting and analytics

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Finance or Accounting
Ideally 5+ years (minimum 3 years) of experience in investment banking, private equity, corporate development, transaction diligence, strategy consulting, or corporate FP&A
MBA or CFA helpful but not required; at least one promotion in prior role preferred
Strong analytical toolkit and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated critical thinking and analytical rigor
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex analysis into crisp executive summaries and narratives
Advanced Excel and financial modeling capabilities, including leverage of AI tools
Strong PowerPoint and executive communication skills
Strong relationship-building skills and ability to work effectively with senior leaders, finance, technology, legal, and other functional teams
Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt in a fast-paced environment
High ownership, intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, discretion, and willingness to do hands-on work
Expert financial knowledge including strong understanding of income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statements
Experience working with large data sets and generating insights
High-potential mindset with the ability to grow into leadership roles within Corporate FP&A

Benefits & Perks

Medical, Dental & Vision benefits available the 1st month after hire
Automatic enrollment into our 401k plan
Virtual fitness classes offered company-wide
Robust PTO offerings including major holidays, vacation, sick, personal, & volunteer time
Employee discounts with major providers
Philanthropic support with both local and national organizations
Fun culture with company-wide contests and prizes

title: Trading Executive
description:
Bauer Media Outdoor is one of the UK’s leading Out of Home media owners and infrastructure companies, with more than 33,000 advertising sites in our portfolio. Our talented team of over 600+ people work in 14 locations across the country, creating and delivering some of the most memorable advertising campaigns in the UK.

We are committed to providing a Platform for Brands and a Platform for Good. We’re transforming our estate and practices. We’re building a sustainable business that benefits our many public, partners, and advertiser stakeholders through the provision of ad-funded social infrastructure, digital innovation, and proactive efforts that benefit society.

The Bauer Media Outdoor Way helps us deliver more impact for advertisers, with more value for communities, and less impact on our planet.

About the role….

We’re looking for an individual who is ready to start their OOH media career as a Trading Executive, learning all aspects of the business before taking on client-specific commercial responsibility.

As a member of our agile, collaborative Trading Team you will develop detailed systems and product knowledge working on a wide range of tasks. You will work with multiple internal stakeholders to build your understanding of our business and our client’s requirements. You will quickly work towards taking specific responsibility for key out of home specialist relationships using your knowledge to deliver unique client solutions.

Whilst much of your initial workload will be driven by reactive requirements you will be expected to proactively promote Bauer Media’s success by selling in enhanced solutions both in the short and long term.

What you’ll be doing….

  • Build and maintain relationships with aligned Specialists,
  • Respond promptly and accurately to briefs
  • Question client requirements and prepare briefs that accurately reflect their needs
  • Seek opportunities to proactively educate and inspire customers both over the phone and face to face
  • Align clients need and requirements to BMO’s offering taking advantage of all data and insight
  • Demonstrate smart negotiation skills making use of all internal resources
  • Efficiently use all internal systems to accurately record and manage bookings
  • Build outstanding knowledge of the Bauer Media Outdoor product portfolio, it’s pricing and packaging
  • You'll work with multiple internal stakeholders to build your understanding of our business and establish shared sales strategies
  • Understand current availability and proactively sell more exposed formats.
  • Work to exceed Specialist targets through selling, upselling, and cross selling products Specialists

What we are looking for….

  • A task-driven, numerate individual who takes pride in delivering excellent client service to help maximise sales revenue
  • A customer-focused professional with strong communication skills
  • Someone who enjoys developing new relationships into long-term, strong commercial partnerships
  • An analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and draw meaningful conclusions
  • You enjoy building swift, effective solutions
  • Comfortable working at pace within a commercial environment
  • Highly self-motivated, with the ability to plan and manage multiple briefs simultaneously
  • A proactive team player who works collaboratively towards team and wider business goals

What’s in it for you?

  • Salary of £30,500 + Quarterly Group commission
  • Flexible working and a hybrid setup (this typically look like 3 days in the office and 2 days WFH)
  • Enjoy 25 paid holidays, including those well need bank holidays!
  • Company Pension Scheme Contribution of up to 8%
  • Stay healthy with our Healthcare Cash Plan
  • Life Insurance and group income protection scheme
  • Cycle to Work Scheme + Enjoy travel/season ticket loans and exclusive discounts with hundreds of retailers
  • Make a difference with our charity volunteer days. It feels great to give back!

At Bauer Media Outdoor, we are committed to treating everyone with fairness and respect, regardless of their race, gender, age, ethnicity, background, sexual orientation, disability, or any other differences. We work hard to foster an inclusive environment, a place you can be yourself. We support reasonable adjustment requests from candidates and employees. If you're interested in joining us to shape the future of out-of-home media, we'd love to hear from you.

If you need this job description in another format or need any adjustments for your application/interview process, please let us know at careers-uk@bauermediaoutdoor.com

title: FT Receiver (Attridge Food #390) Saskatoon, SK - Saskatoon Co-op
description:
Reporting to the Food Store Manager, responsibilities for this position include the following:

  1. To come to work with a positive, professional approach and attitude.

  2. To be dependable for all scheduled shifts.

  3. To receive, warehouse, unpack, check, deliver and ship merchandise on a regular basis in all departments.

  4. To maintain current and accurate records of all merchandise entering or leaving the unit warehouse in accordance with prescribed procedures.

  5. To be familiar with the lines of merchandise handled in the various departments to the degree required to identify possible errors when merchandise is being received.

  6. To advise the responsible manager of the merchandise received, and to move it into position for placement on the floor or for storage, as required.

  8. To assemble damaged merchandised as received in the warehouse and advise the responsible manager for markdown recording and claims preparation.

  9. To initiate claims for damaged or short-shipped merchandise as assigned.

  10. Receive/Process direct vendor delivers ensuring they are correct and damaged free.

  12. To keep aisles and exits clear of obstruction at all times as required to comply with existing fire regulations.

  13. To unpack, uncrate, and otherwise prepare for shipment and receiving such items as heavy hardware, major appliances, home entertainment goods, etc.

  14. To be responsible for the security of the warehouse area - receiving doors locked at all times except when receiving or shipping merchandise; in and out shipments properly accounted for.

  15. To maintain constant alert against unauthorized removal of merchandise.

  16. To adhere to all Saskatoon Co-op policies and procedures.

  17. To operate all equipment in a safe responsible manner.

  18. Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

title: Counselor
description:
Full-Time Counselor | Roseville, CA

Pinnacle’s Voice: A Tale of Transformation & Recovery

“I found myself like a lot of people in a position I never thought I would be in. I needed help bad… It all started with a call… one of the easiest and hardest things I’ve ever done. Every day I wake up and think how good it feels and how lucky I am to have found this place.”

-Patient, Pinnacle Treatment Centers

About Us: Pinnacle Treatment Centers is a leading provider of comprehensive addiction treatment services, committed to transforming lives through compassionate care. Our approach is rooted in evidence-based practices, focusing on the holistic well-being of our patients, and treating our teammates with the same level of individualized compassion and empathy. We believe in providing a supportive and inclusive environment for both our patients and our dedicated team of professionals. Pinnacle transforms the lives of more than 35,000 individuals daily resulting in a network of care spanning across the country.

Position Overview: As a Counselor, you will play a crucial role in the recovery journey of our patients. Pinnacle’s unique approach combines compassionate care with innovative treatment methods to address the diverse needs of individuals seeking help for substance use disorders. Join us in making a positive impact on the lives of those we serve.

Teammate Appreciation Benefits: At Pinnacle Treatment Centers, we value our teammates and offer a variety of benefits to support their personal and professional growth.

1. Variable Pay Structure: Competitive compensation based on experience, education, and licensure.

2. Defined Career Pathing: Clear advancement opportunities through our Counselor Tier Program, designed to reward achievement in education, licensure, and credentials.

3. Bonus Incentives: Recognizing and rewarding quality patient care with monthly performance-based bonuses.

4. STAR LRP Eligibility: 90% of our facilities are eligible for the Student Loan Repayment Program. This federal program selects applicants to forgive 100% of their student loans.

5. Continuing Education: Free access to over 600 CEU courses to enhance your skills and knowledge.

6. Paid Time Off: 18 days of PTO, sick leave, and 8 paid holidays to maintain a healthy work-life balance.

7. Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Initiatives: Be part of a workforce that reflects the diversity of our patient population.

8. Free Clinical Supervision: Available based on licensure and availability to support your professional growth.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provides orientation to new patients to the programs’ rules, policies, procedures, and patients' rights.
  • Conduct Intakes, Discharge Planning, Initial Assessments, and Initial Treatment Plans professionally and within time guidelines as required by applicable federal and state regulation, CARF guidelines and Pinnacle Policies.
  • Involve patients in the assessment, treatment planning, and intervention aspects of treatment, which provides the patient with a sense of entitlement to their own recovery.
  • Administer the biopsychosocial assessment, which evaluates all areas of patients' lives, including their addictions, medical and mental health history, socioeconomics, legal, etc. at intake and on an ongoing basis.
  • Recognize and utilize patients’ Strengths, Needs, Ability, and Preferences (SNAP), to develop and implement individualized Treatment Plans that effectively help patients to meet their short & long-term goals. • Determine the clinical necessity of counseling services based on the clinical assessment and evaluation of the patients.
  • Monitor closely, and document any change of circumstances with the patients, especially as it relates to matters that may affect their recovery, identifying and addressing relapse indicators to promote relapse prevention interventions in an early stage.
  • Comply with and implement the Medical Q.A (Quality Assurance) and Clinical Risk Management Policies, including:
    • Evaluate the patients for any high-risk conditions (e.g., liver failure, pregnancy, overdose, bipolar, schizophrenia, etc.), which may endanger the patient (suicidal) or other parties (homicidal).
    • Administer the BAM-R, C-SSRS, GAD-7, and PHQ-9 screening tools to determine the severity of the patient's mental/emotional status.
    • Evaluate the risk factors concerning each such case, considering the appropriateness of, and professionalism in treating such individuals in an OTP in comparison to treatment in a residential facility or other treatment modalities.
    • Review and ask about other practitioners' involvement in the treatment of these high-risk conditions. Recommend immediate referral to such a specialist in case of need. Request the patient sign a waiver for release of information which will allow communication with the other practitioner in case of need (e.g., deterioration of the patient’s condition).
    • Flag high-risk patients to the Medical Directors, Physician Extenders, and Regional Clinical Leadership (RCL) and highlight the conditions concerned.
    • Refer such patients to the Medical Directors, Physician Extenders or RCLs (Regional Clinical Leadership) based on the urgency, utilizing the informal Referral Policy or the scheduled Treatment Team/Case Conference session.
    • Review physician notes, following the Medical Directors or Physician Extenders’ session with the patient, verifying that they noted and addressed the high-risk factor, or otherwise bring it immediately to the attention of the supervising counselor, as well as the clinic manager, until the matter’s proper and professional handling by the physician or physician extender.
    • Advise, in writing, other staff members (including the clinic manager, supervising counselor, dispensing nurse and front office) of high-risk patients and their condition. Maintain and circulate minutes from treatment team/case conference sessions to the other staff members.
  • Provide professional counseling and referral services by:
    • Addressing patients’ clinical and special needs by maintaining referrals to specialized (“second tier”) services rendered by physicians, physician extenders and counselors within Aegis, as well as referrals to Keys to Recovery (or other twelve-step) support groups, and other community resources (e.g., agencies and practitioners outside of Aegis), acting as a liaison to these agencies, as necessary.
    • Providing individual and group counseling as clinically necessary, to address the problem issues identified in the Initial Assessment and Treatment Plans. The counseling service will include protocols for the treatment of Relapse Prevention, Peer Pressure, Anger Management, Domestic Violence, Parenting, Family Preservation, Vocational Rehabilitation, etc.
    • Utilizing advanced counseling techniques such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Motivational Interviewing, etc.
    • Scheduling regular counseling sessions with patients; issue patient appointment cards and record scheduled or rescheduled sessions in EHR scheduler.
    • Documenting counseling entries, including signature and date, as required by applicable federal and state regulations, CARF guidelines and Pinnacle policies.
    • Engaging in Community Relations and Outreach efforts.
    • Attending all recommended training including Physician Training of Counselors, RCL training, and case conferences with the program physicians and physician assistants.
    • Collecting research data when requested.
    • Observing the collection of patients’ urine samples when required
    • Attend team meetings and complete all training courses timely as required.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

Counselor I: $20/hour to $21/hour

  • Possess an associate degree in relevant field and has the registration/credentials necessary to provide counseling services to our patient population.
    • Kern County requires a bachelor’s degree or High school diploma/GED with 75% certification education.

    Preferred

    • Possess a bachelor's degree or higher

    Counselor II: $21/hour to $24/hour

    • Possess an associate degree in a relevant field or a majority of approved counselor certification courses, license, or certification necessary to provide counseling services to our patient population. Kern County requires a bachelor's degree or 75% of required counselor certification courses)
    • Possess counselor registration/certification by a “Certifying Organization: recognized by the Department of Alcohol and Drug Programs. Proof of registration is required immediately once employed with a California Alcohol and Drug Program certifying body. Employees must be registered prior to providing any counseling services per the DHCS (Department of Health Care Services).
    • 2-5 years of experience OR Master level

    Counselor III: $24/hour to $27/hour (Certified) & $27/hour - $30/hour (Licensed)

    • Degrees must include being licensed, licensed eligible, or certified. Clinical skills must be effective in complex cases. Along with the below:
    • Possess certification as an Alcohol and Other Drug Counselor with a CA approved certification agency or current credentials as licensed or license-eligible with the Board of Behavioral Sciences or the Board of Psychology. If license-eligible, must maintain the Board’s requirements to be able to practice including receiving the necessary amount of clinical supervision by a Board approved supervisor.
    • Proof of licensure or certification by a State approved regulatory agency is required immediately once employed. Employees must be credentialed prior to providing any counseling services per the DHCS (Department of Health Care Services).

    Join our Team & Start Saving Lives Today

title: Software Engineer, Android
description:
Our Mission

As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing.

We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more.


Our Values
  • Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.
  • Move Fast: We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today.
  • Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate.
  • Real Talk: We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same.
  • Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us.
  • Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters.

The Team

The Engineering team is responsible for building innovative features and resilient systems that bring people together. We're always experimenting with new features to engage with our members. Although we are a high-scale tech company, the member-to-engineer ratio is very high—making the level of impact each engineer gets to have at Tinder enormous.

As an Android engineer at Tinder, you will have an outsized impact and ownership of the most visible aspects of the Tinder App. We are deeply invested in challenging norms, constantly improving architecture design, exploring emergent tech and ideas, and leveraging new technologies in interesting ways to deliver an app that is widely known across the world.

Where you’ll work:

This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration three times per week in our Los Angeles office.

In this role, you will:

  • Contribute to the architecture, design, and implementation of consumer-facing features in the Tinder App using the latest technologies

  • Build new compelling in-app experiences that will reach millions of users globally

  • Coordinate with the product and design team(s) to influence the roadmap and product development of the Tinder App and services

  • Create and maintain internal shared frameworks and libraries

  • Shape the future of optimized analytics at Tinder from the ground up with innovative data tools for the analytics and data scientist team(s)

  • Evolve Tinder’s architecture to support multiple authentication flows and account management

You'll need:

  • Experience building native Android applications

  • Experience building applications in Kotlin

  • Well versed in design patterns ( MVP, Clean/MVVM)

  • Experience writing your own Repositories and Factories

  • Understanding of the value of Dependency Injection

  • Experience writing your own test scripts

  • Proficiency using coroutines

  • Clear and solutions oriented communication style with a passion for code quality

Nice to have:

  • Experience designing and architecting full-stack applications, including API design and UI wireframing

  • Experience working with Android Push Notifications

  • Someone who understands material design guidelines (e.g. you know how to be a good Android citizen while maintaining a strong unique brand identity)

  • Clear communication style within a collaborative team environment

  • The ability to combine good judgment, empathy, and technical skills

  • BS or MS in Computer Science or Engineering

The salary range for this position is $95,000 - $115,000. Factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, job-related skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations may influence base pay offered. This salary range is reflective of a position based in Los Angeles, California. This salary will be subject to a geographic adjustment (according to a specific city and state), if an authorization is granted to work outside of the location listed in this posting.

As a full-time employee, you’ll enjoy:
  • Flexible Vacation, 10 Sick Days
  • Time off to volunteer and charitable donations matched up to $15,000 annually
  • Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage
  • 100% 401(k) employer match up to 10%, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  • 100% paid parental leave (including for non-birthing parents) and family forming benefits
  • Investment in your development: mentorship through our MentorMatch program, access to 6,000+ online courses through Udemy, and an annual $3,000 stipend for your professional development
  • Investment in your wellness: access to mental health support via Modern Health, paid concierge medical membership, pet insurance, fitness membership subsidy, and commuter subsidy
  • Free subscription to Tinder Gold

Commitment to Inclusion
At Tinder, we don’t just accept difference, we celebrate it. We strive to build a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of our members around the world, and we value unique perspectives and backgrounds. Even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications, we invite you to apply and show us how your skills could transfer.
