title: Lead Technician
description:
Come and work for a company that continues to grow and flourish and where our people make a difference! McDonald Plastic Molding is a subsidiary of A.Y. McDonald Industries, which is a family-owned company founded in 1856. People join our business (and stay) because of our collaborative workplace, drive for innovation, and our family-oriented culture. We are a custom injection molding company known for producing high-quality products that meet the needs of our customers.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Process Technician

  • Perform an initial startup on a new production run after mold sets are complete.
  • Work on processes to improve production efficiencies and reduce high scrap rates.
  • Research problems with equipment and tooling and take corrective action.
  • Trouble shoot process issues in the factory and consult with tool designer and project engineers for solutions to the problems.
  • Recommend measures to improve production methods, equipment performance, and quality of product.
  • Document and record processes for all production runs for each customer.
  • Perform daily rounds and checks at each workstation:
    • Are all waterlines on and circulating through the molds and mold heater units
    • Is water on the barrel throats
    • Waterlines are routed to the mold properly and don’t have leaky fittings
    • Water tanks are circulating and the heaters are working if used
    • Drop bars are set properly
    • Dryers are working and setup correctly
    • Review of all electrical cords, air hoses, oil temperature, etc.
  • Set mold and start jobs according to standard procedures as instructed by supervisor or upper management.
  • Set-up and changeover of equipment used for performing secondary and degating operations at the molding machines. (Tables, Conveyors, Water Tanks, Degaters, Fixtures, etc.
  • Perform all aspects of changeover required for converting molding machines to various production of sample jobs.
  • Put things in proper places when pulling jobs out. Mold inserts, fixtures, switches, valves, etc. . .
  • Perform minor mold maintenance and repair, including cavity, core and/or base changeover, as required.
  • To perform preventive maintenance and minor equipment repairs when necessary as required.
  • Keep inventory in order of heater bands, mold clamps, bolts, hoses, knockout rods.
  • Have a good knowledge of all machines and their functions and make sure your set-up people have this knowledge
  • Maintain good communications with your Quality Control Department to insure quality products are produced on your shift and at start-up.
  • Follow established procedures for the proper storage of molds and equipment.
  • Keep set-up records in order and insure that set-up records are 100% accurate when filling them out.
  • Take care of the equipment – use proper length bolts to fasten molds so threads are not stripped, watch centering rings, bumping of machines tie bards, safety gates and drop bars with the mold. Use care with auxiliary equipment. DME units fastened so as not to fall on the floor, water heats, etc. . . Overall put a little extra thought in everyday duties that you perform.
  • Stage molds and equipment for upcoming jobs.
  • Stage break periods so machinery is not left idle. This may require and early or late break.
  • To assist with required machine and/or equipment adjustments and troubleshooting to insure safe, efficient operations as directed by shift supervisor.
  • Operator the forklift as required.
  • Report problems, needs, and equipment breakdowns to your supervisor so it can be corrected.
  • Accurately complete all record keeping forms.
  • When required, to perform any job in a lower rated classification that is necessary to support plant operations safely and efficiently.
  • Assist in secondary work as needed and as time permits:
    • Assembly, print, sort, drill or gauge parts.
    • Give breaks.
    • Operate a machine.
  • Spend adequate time before and after each shift to ensure all information is properly passed onto oncoming shifts.
  • Be available to work overtime as needed.
  • If something, does not seem quite right question it and report it to your supervisor immediately.
  • Adhere to all company policies regarding conduct, safety practices, and job performance.
  • When called upon or in case of an emergency, be qualified to assume supervisor's responsibilities on a temporary basis.
  • All other duties as assigned by your shift supervisor or management.

    Strategic planning for the growth and success of McDonald Plastic Molding.

    • Participate in-group and individual training.
    • Develop and implement McDonald Plastic Molding’s core values and mission statement.
    • Perform all duties in a safe manner while supporting and encouraging the company’s safety culture.
    • Determine personal strengths and delegate workload that best fits each individual.
    • Maintain a clean, organized and safe working environment.
    • Perform all job duties with a positive, collaborative, and encouraging attitude.

    SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

    Directly supervise employees on any/all shifts in the factory departments. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

    PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

    The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

    While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee frequently is required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to climb or balance, talk or hear, and taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 75 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, and depth perception.

    BENEFITS

    Benefits include major medical (BCBS), Delta dental and vision, company sponsored basic life insurance and short-term disability. Voluntary life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment, and long-term disability available. Competitive 401(k) with company matching, generous PTO, 10 paid holidays, and company giveaways, family picnics, and more!

    A pre-employment and 9 panel (no THC) Drug screen required.

    McDonald Plastic Molding is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Technologist Assistant - MRI - Per Diem
description:

Position SummaryThe MRI Technologist Aide supports MRI technologists and radiology staff in delivering safe, efficient, and high-quality patient care. title: Processing Tech I
location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
description:
Schedule:
7-On/7-Off A Week
8:30 PM - 7:00 AM

Training Schedule:
Monday - Friday
1:00 PM - 9:30 PM (flexible)

Department: University Specimen Processing - 423

*Hourly rate is an estimate only which includes shift differential for nights, evenings or weekend shifts. Overall hourly rates will vary based on schedule

Primary Purpose:

Upon completion of training program, works under general supervision to ensure proper handling of all specimens received at ARUP's central facility and/or University Hospital Clinical Lab.

About ARUP:

ARUP Laboratories is a national clinical and anatomic pathology reference laboratory and an enterprise of the University of Utah and its Department of Pathology. Based in Salt Lake City, Utah.

ARUP proudly hires top talent to create a work environment of diversity, professional growth and continuous development. Our workforce is committed to the important service we provide to over one million patients each month. We always strive for excellence and have a strong desire to have involvement with the advances in medicine and the role laboratory services plays within each patient’s life. We never forget that there is a patient behind every specimen we receive.

We are looking for individuals who want to contribute to ARUP's culture of accountability, integrity, service, and excellence. Consider joining our dynamic team.

Essential Functions:

Reads and signs the Specimen Processing Procedure Manual and Safety Manual.

Attends Specimen Processing team and staff meetings.

Assigned to a POD upon successful completion of Specimen Processing training.

Immediately processes specimens as they become available.

Enter patient demographics and process specimens/orders using the appropriate applications.

Order all tests indicated on the requisition.

Process all manual and electronically transmitted tests on submitted paperwork.

Properly comments any additional information on the requisition/packing list.

Look for any problems and order EXCEPT TT tests as necessary.

Handles and labels all specimens and paperwork appropriately.

Able to recognize and appropriate handle all specimen types per corporate and departmental procedure.

Properly documents all specimen receipt information as outlined in departmental procedures.

Properly documents the appropriate client provided information on specimen labels.

Ensures the all appropriate identifiers are checked on all received specimens/paperwork and electronically. Must ensure all match and the all specimens are labelled correctly.

Properly handles specimens requiring a reroute or to be shared.

Places processed specimens on the automated track, or at the appropriate temperature for manual sorting, or delivers to the testing laboratory at the proper temperature if automated delivery systems are not available.

Able to process specimens at all three temperatures and follow the appropriate procedures for all manual and electronically transmitted orders.

Properly operates the biological safety cabinet.

University Hospital: Where applicable, correctly prepares specimens for delivery between ARUP testing facilities (e.g. CF-to-UHCL or UHCL-to-CF) by creating STLs and packaging according to specimen temperature and properly operates the centrifuge.

Knows ARUP and UHSC laboratories and able to determine their locations, hours of operations, and general functions (or able to find such information using departmental information on Nucleus).

Ability to make sound judgement decisions or checks with Supervisor, Lead, or Workflow Coordinator when needed, before making such decisions.

Assists the management team in handling more complex processing needs including specimen searches and processing compromised shipments when needed.

Observes principles of data security and patient confidentiality. Maintains ethical standards in the performance of testing and in interactions with patients, co-workers and other health care professionals.

Adheres to all safety policies and regulations including, but not limited to, proper dress code and using proper protective clothing and other equipment.

Remains informed of all procedures pertaining to specimen processing.

Performs cleaning duties as assigned.

Assists with departmental projects.

Other duties as assigned.

Physical and Other Requirements:

Stooping: Bending body downward and forward by bending spine at the waist.

Reaching: Extending hand(s) and arm(s) in any direction.

Mobility: The person in this position needs to move between work sites and inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc

Effective communication skills

PPE: Biohazard laboratory environment that requires use of personal protective equipment in accordance with CDC and OSHA regulations and company/departmental policies.

ARUP Policies and Procedures: To conduct self in compliance with all ARUP Policies and Procedures.

Abide by the Code of Conduct as outlined in the ARUP employee handbook.

Medium Work: Exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 30 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

Fine Motor Control: Picking, pinching, typing or otherwise working, primarily with fingers rather than with the whole hand as in handling.

Vision: Having close, far, and peripheral visual acuity to perform a variety of tasks such as make general observations of depth and distance.

Color Vision: Perception of and ability to distinguish colors

Performance Expectations: Regular and reliable attendance. Reliable and dependable performance. Ability to work well with others. Ability to work all required overtime.

title: Systems Test Engineer 3
description:
Requisition ID: 2212

Standard Weekly Hours: 40.00

Location: ULA - Denver

Relocation: Yes- Relocation may be available

Travel Requirements: 25%

At ULA, success comes through the efforts of a strong, united team.

Thanks for your interest in United Launch Alliance, the world's most experienced and reliable space launch company! Successfully launching more than 155 consecutive missions with 100% mission success doesn't happen by accident. It's a testament to the commitment and dedication of our team of rocket scientists and support employees combined with the systems and processes we use to pull them together. As a ULA employee, you'll have the opportunity to grow in your career while working in a team-oriented culture that combines technology, innovation, ingenuity and a commitment to the extraordinary. Whether you are in college just launching your career, or, have experience and want to come work with the best rocket team in the world, our unshakable unity yields stronger solutions and better results as we carry out our mission to save lives, explore the universe, and connect the world. Our team is excited to meet you!

Job Overview & Responsibilities

This position will support the ULA Enterprise through being a System Test Project Manager, driving test execution of launch vehicle systems. This candidate will report to the Airborne Systems and Development Systems Engineering, Integration, and Test leader. Responsibilities include:

  • Cross-functional technical project management and integration for test requirement development, test scope, management of schedules, test article builds, instrumentation, logistics, test planning, and test house selection to execute the test.
  • Compliance with ULA processes governing test planning and execution, author and review test report summaries, test requirement documents, and SOWs and facilitate the release process of these documents.
  • Driving the development and technical convergence of test requirements, lead test integration efforts, establish test methods, and operational process development.
  • System Test trade study development and management to include outbriefing leadership on test trade outcomes.
  • Risk, issue, and opportunity management as it relates to the applicable test campaign.
  • Requirements verification activities, customer relationship communication, proposal support, and Gate Review preparation and execution.
  • Working with the cross-functional test team to generate and lead Test Readiness Reviews (TRR).
  • Being able to lead through influence to work with the broader organization.
  • Driving continuous improvement in test processes and automation.
  • Ensuring all testing complies with safety, quality, and regulatory requirements.

Required Education

Bachelor

Required Years of Experience

Minimum of 4 years of related work experience

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field is required from an accredited college or university.
  • Approx. 30%-40%Travel Required, more during test campaigns you are leading.
  • 4+ years of related Engineering experience.
  • Understanding of Systems Engineering principles, requirements verification, and validation methods.
  • Understanding of test design, requirements, and operations.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams, trade study management, and risk management.
  • Good communicator, extremely organized, able to develop and track schedules.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience and background with previous development programs to design / build a new product from scratch or enhance an existing product is preferred.
  • Experience with system level design reviews or major gate reviews (e.g. SRR, PDR, CDR, etc.) and presenting to a diverse customer audience.
  • Experience with integrated system level testing Structural, Dynamic, Environmental, Propulsion).
  • Experience with instrumentation, sensors, and Data Acquisition systems.
  • Familiarity with the Test-Like-You-Fly philosophy.
  • Knowledge of Aerospace/Defense systems.

Summary Salary Range (for ULA - Denver only): $99,604.00 - $166,007.00

Please note that the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon a candidate's experience and qualifications, as well as internal equity, market and business considerations. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus in addition to base pay.

What makes ULA different?

Because we understand launch success comes through the collective efforts of a team, we seek the best to join us. We value ethics, ingenuity, engagement and professional development for employees at all levels.

We offer our employees competitive pay and benefits including:

  • 401(k) match plus an additional employer contribution

title: Cloud Response Subject Matter Expert (SME)
description:
Resource Management Concepts, Inc. (RMC) provides high-quality, professional services to government and commercial sectors. Our mission is to deliver exceptional management and technology solutions supporting the protection and preservation of the people and environment of the United States of America.

RMC is hiring a Cloud Response Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support our customer in Quantico, VA. The Cloud Response SME will build and maintain detection use cases to detect unauthorized activity. They will also assist with incident investigation and help the customer design and implement new defensive cyberspace tools in cloud computing environments.

The selected applicant will perform a variety of activities including but not limited to:

  • Developing detection use cases specifically focused on detecting unauthorized activity in cloud computing environments using the customer’s existing cloud computing defense tools.
  • Assisting with the investigation of and response to cyberspace incidents involving cloud computing environments and technologies.
  • Assisting the customer with designing and deploying new capabilities in cloud computing environments.
  • Demonstrating effectiveness by successfully identifying and preventing Red Team activity in the customer’s cloud computing environment.
  • Updating tactics, techniques, procedures, training, and education documentation as needed.
  • Preparing and presenting a course that covers the basics of Cloud Computing security, common attack scenarios, and specific tactics, techniques, processes, and procedures.
  • Providing support to maintain the customer’s CSSP accreditation per the standards, including documentation and technical writing support.

Requirements

  • Active TS/SCI (DoD TOP SECRET clearance with SCI eligibility) is required. Applicant selected will be subject to security investigation(s) and must maintain eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
  • Five (5) years of practical experience in a Cybersecurity, Engineering, T&E, or A&A-related field (Cloud Investigations, Incident Response, Detection Engineering, etc.)
  • College degree in a technical or managerial-related discipline; OR a High School diploma/H.S. equivalency certificate with seven (7+) years of experience in Cybersecurity, Engineering, T&E, or A&A.
  • DoD/W 8570 IAT Level III certification (valid/current)
  • DoD/W 8570 CSSP Analyst certification (valid/current)
  • Future requirement (in lieu of DoD/W 8570 certification requirements): DoD/W 8140 Cyber Workforce (DCWF) Role 511 Cyber Defense Analyst (i.e., CCNA Cybersecurity, CySA+, CFR, GCFA, GCIA, GICSP) and/or 531 Cyber Defense Incident Responder (i.e., CISSP, CySA+, CFR, GCFA, GCIA, GICSP) certification at the Advanced Proficiency Level.

Desired (one or more of the following)

  • Cloud-specific certifications (valid/current):
  • CompTIA Cloud+
  • CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional)
  • Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional
  • AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
  • Google Associate Cloud Engineer

This position is considered essential and will be required to report during hazardous weather, power outages, fuel shortages, pandemics, and other emergencies.

Benefits

At RMC, we're committed to your career growth! RMC differentiates itself from other firms through its investment in our employees. We invest our resources to train, certify, educate, and build our employees.

RMC can offer you a great place to work with a small company feel and give you the experience, tuition assistance, and certifications that will take your career to the next level. This also includes a competitive paid vacation package with 11 paid federal holidays. Additionally, we also offer high-quality, low-deductible healthcare plans, pet insurance, and a competitive 401K package.

Salary at RMC is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, a candidate's specific combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific requirements. The current salary range for this position will be $155,000 to $175,000 (annually).

title: Sr. Global Product Manager - Semiconductor
description:
Who Are We?
Do you want to help to make the world a better place? Join our team! At TSI our vision is to create a better world by helping to protect people, products and the environment. We are proud of the wide range of solutions we provide that solve our customer’s problems around the world. From helping to ensure worker safety and understanding air quality to supporting complex highly technical industries such as pharmaceuticals manufacturing, semiconductor, and research customers, TSI employees are part of something special with a purpose.

Sr. Global Product Manager – Semiconductor at TSI
The Sr. Global Product Manager is responsible for growing TSI’s technology presence within the global semiconductor ecosystem of suppliers and fabs. TSI has industry-leading technology for measuring contaminants in liquids and gases. This role will develop the strategies to enable TSI technology to become the leading and preferred measurement technology for the semiconductor market.

The Sr. Global Product Manager provides strategic input to the product roadmap, executes on projects defined in the roadmap, and participates as a key member on new product development teams. The role is responsible for identifying business opportunities, developing strategic partnerships, conducting Voice of Customer (VOC), developing value propositions, and associated business and customer product requirements. The Sr. Global Product Manager leads the requirement definition for new product development (NPD) efforts. The natural initial focus of the role will be for products to serve the semiconductor market, but TSI products are also applicable to many other markets.

This role works closely with internal departments, including Product Development, Business Development, Downstream Marketing, Sales, and Marketing Communications, in the definition and execution of planned initiatives designed to optimize growth and profitability of TSI’s Particle Instruments products. This position is responsible for managing product strategy and roadmaps, including hardware, software and services, and for meeting annually established financial and strategic objectives, set by the Business Director.

What Will You Do?

In order to grow and build a successful career with TSI, you will:

  • Lead strategy and execute initiatives to establish TSI spray drying and particle counting technologies as a standard within the semiconductor ecosystem of suppliers. Identify and develop trusted relationships and partnerships across the industry and align internal TSI resources (engineering, applications, sales) to establish TSI technology into key semiconductor companies.
  • Annual strategic planning — translate semiconductor drivers (fab roadmaps, node transitions, competitive trends) into NPD strategy and project priorities that keep contamination detection ahead of the most advanced nodes.
  • Analyze market drivers, technology developments, intellectual property landscape, regulatory drivers, and competitor positioning of assigned product line segments. Lead new product development strategy and project priorities, based on findings.
  • Develop business cases for identified opportunities, including revenue potential, market risks and uncertainties, and collaborate with engineering and sales to develop ROI estimates for recommended product/service proposals.
  • Lead cross-functional innovation teams to develop new product and service strategies. Encourage free thinking and collaboration amongst the team, but make sure that they remain focused on the business objective you have provided.
  • Conduct and coordinate market research, competitive assessments, and Voice of Customer research. Travel, as needed, to support activities, such as VOC efforts, training, new product launches, and visiting customers and potential business partners.
  • Work closely with Product Development teams, providing customer needs (critical customer requirements) input. Along with Project Manager and Systems Engineer, provide leadership to the Product Development team and collaborate with lead customers to prove out our solutions and ensure success in the market. Be an active team member, professionally completing assigned NPD process documentation.
  • Analyze financial performance of released products. Make ROI-based decisions on continuation engineering activities and margin improvement opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Downstream Marketing on sales training, go-to-market plans, and pricing models. Build strong cross-functional relationships throughout the global organization to maximize influence, without direct authority.
  • Partner with Business Development team to define strategic product/technology gaps. Identify potential collaboration partners and acquisitions to fill identified gaps.

What Do You Need?
Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering/Science or related field
  • 7+ years of progressive Product Management experience, exhibiting increased levels of responsibility in scope
  • Proven track record of B2B experience
  • Experience with strategic marketing plans, including clearly defined product roadmap for the product line
  • Familiar with voice of customer methodology, strategic marketing framework, and pricing tools and techniques

Desired

  • Advanced degree (i.e. MSc or PhD); MBA
  • Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes, including tools/equipment, liquids/chemical and/or gases, aerosol science and technology, and/or contamination measurement and control domain experience
  • International Business experience
  • Experience in instrumentation
  • Operational experience (manufacturing, technical support, engineering)

Travel

  • 25-50% travel is expected, including international, especially to Asia, including Japan, Korea, and Taiwan

What Can We Give You?
At TSI, our employees are our most valuable assets, and we care about their health and happiness. We offer a competitive benefits program to keep our employees and their family members protected and foster a healthy work-life balance. Additionally, we are committed to employee development and growth, and encourage and foster an environment of collaboration, and innovation. Our work has meaning and the products we design and build help protect people and the environment.

title: Delivery Manager

We need a hands-on Delivery Manager who can make technical delivery clear, visible, and dependable. You will work directly with our CTO and coordinate engineers and business stakeholders from the first request through release, rollout, and adoption.

What you will do

  • Weigh competing requests against capacity, deadlines, and dependencies, and recommend a delivery sequence with clear trade-offs for the CTO to confirm.
  • Hold senior and business stakeholders to their commitments as firmly as engineers, including pushing back on late changes, out-of-process requests, and unrealistic dates.
  • Propose and negotiate delivery plans, then track the plan confirmed by the CTO.
  • Surface blockers and slippage early, bring options, and escalate material risks through the agreed route.
  • Keep Asana accurate across every initiative and request, including minor tickets.
  • Turn discussions into clear owners, milestones, dates, dependencies, decisions, and next steps.
  • Clarify requirements and acceptance criteria before engineering commits to work.
  • Interview stakeholders and run light business analysis when a request arrives without clear requirements. You turn ambiguity into a workable spec, not just a ticket.
  • Coordinate execution, testing, releases, incidents, support, rollout, and adoption follow-through.
  • Own user acceptance testing before release: confirm the delivered work actually solves the business problem it was meant to solve.
  • Vibecode quick prototypes, scripts, and internal automations to clarify requirements, test ideas, and remove manual delivery work. This doesn't replace engineering's production work.
  • Improve the operating process without adding unnecessary ceremony.

Requirements

  • At least 2-4 years of software Project Management/ Delivery Management ownership, ideally in outsourcing or IT services.
  • Fluent professional Ukrainian and strong Upper-Intermediate English, B2+ minimum; C1 preferred.
  • Experience running 2-4 workstreams.
  • End-to-end experience from discovery or intake through production release, plus maintenance, support, or incidents.
  • Comfortable interviewing stakeholders and writing requirements yourself when there's no dedicated BA.

title: Pool Repair Technician
description:
The YMCA of Metropolitan Fort Worth is looking for an experienced Pool Maintenance Technician to join our team and support the work of the Y, a leading nonprofit committed to strengthening community through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility.
The General Maintenance Technician is responsible for the general maintenance, repair, and upkeep of YMCA facilities while serving as a key resource for the Association's swimming pools and aquatic systems. This position will perform a variety of general facility maintenance duties, including minor plumbing, electrical, carpentry, drywall, painting, and preventative maintenance, with an increased focus on the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of aquatic equipment and systems.
This individual will work closely with YMCA branch leadership and our Facilities team, as well as outside aquatic vendors including PoolSure, Sunbelt Pools, and other pool contractors, service providers, and suppliers, to ensure our pools and aquatic facilities remain safe, operational, and well maintained.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on problem solver who understands that preventative maintenance, timely repairs, strong vendor relationships, and attention to detail are essential to providing safe, high-quality facilities for our members, staff, and community

Our mission and core values are brought to life by our culture. It’s who we are, who we aspire to be and how we show up every day. We are cause-driven. We don’t just show up, we show up with purpose. As a cause driven leader, you are expected to be:

Welcoming – Accept neighbors eagerly, warmly, hospitably, and as equal participants.
Nurturing – To care for, support, and help develop through encouragement.
Hopeful – Take an optimistic or positive view of future outcomes.
Determined – To devote full strength and concentrated attention to the cause.
Genuine – To be honest and open in relationships with others.

We act with intentionality to connect people to our cause. Join us and help transform lives!Qualifications
Education & Certifications: This position requires graduation from an accredited trade school in a related field, and/or 5 years' experience along with demonstrated knowledge in plumbing, electric, carpentry and painting and drywall repair. Must be 18 years old or older. Must be able to lift 75lbs and must have a valid Texas Driver's License.

Experience & Background: High energy, positive, “can-do” attitude, flexibility, teamwork, and attention to detail and high degree of initiative will help this candidate be successful. The ability to direct programs through leading both staff and volunteers, developing and monitoring budgets, developing and marketing programs and bringing enthusiasm and a passion for fundraising. A proven track record in building authentic relationships with others and the ability to establish and maintain collaborations with community organizations. This leader will need the ability to connect and relate with diverse groups of people at all levels of the organization. Bilingual English/Spanish would be a plus.Key Focus Areas

Responds to, prioritizes, and completes facility maintenance work orders in a timely and professional manner, ensuring YMCA facilities remain safe, clean, functional, and welcoming for members, staff, and guests.
Performs routine and preventative maintenance throughout YMCA facilities, including minor plumbing, electrical, carpentry, drywall, painting, doors, windows, fixtures, hardware, and other general building repairs.
Conducts routine facility inspections, identifies potential safety concerns and preventative maintenance needs, and addresses issues before they result in equipment failure, facility disruption, or unnecessary expense.
Serves as a primary maintenance resource for YMCA aquatic facilities, performing routine inspections and preventative maintenance of swimming pools, pool equipment, and aquatic mechanical systems.
Monitors and troubleshoots pool pumps, motors, filtration systems, chemical systems, heaters, boilers, circulation systems, valves, controllers, and other related aquatic equipment to support safe and reliable pool operations.
Works collaboratively with Aquatics and branch leadership to identify and address equipment or mechanical concerns that may impact water quality, temperature, circulation, programming, member usage, or overall pool operations.
Coordinates timely repairs of pool and facility equipment to minimize closures and interruptions to YMCA programs and services.
Serves as a primary maintenance contact for PoolSure, Sunbelt Pools, and other pool and facility vendors, contractors, and service providers, coordinating service calls, preventative maintenance, repairs, inspections, equipment installations, and other facility needs.
Works directly with vendors and contractors to troubleshoot issues, obtain quotes, evaluate repair or replacement options, coordinate onsite work, and ensure identified maintenance needs are appropriately addressed.
Maintains preventative maintenance schedules for facility and aquatic equipment and assists leadership in identifying equipment approaching the end of its useful life and planning for major repairs, replacement, and future capital needs.
Maintains accurate documentation of work orders, preventative maintenance, vendor services, equipment repairs, warranties, inspections, and other facility maintenance activities.
Communicates regularly with YMCA leadership regarding significant maintenance concerns, equipment failures, repair status, anticipated costs, vendor recommendations, and project timelines.
Ensures maintenance activities support applicable YMCA standards and local, state, and federal safety requirements and follows appropriate procedures when working with pool chemicals, mechanical equipment, electrical systems, and other potentially hazardous materials or equipment.
Maintains mechanical rooms, pool equipment areas, chemical storage areas, maintenance spaces, tools, and equipment in a safe, clean, and organized condition.
Immediately communicates conditions that could impact member or staff safety and partners with Aquatics and branch leadership when a maintenance issue may require modification or temporary suspension of pool operations.
Assists with emergency maintenance situations and other facility needs as required while demonstrating flexibility, teamwork, sound judgment, and a commitment to protecting YMCA facilities and resources.

Leadership Competencies

Communication & Influence: Listens and expresses self effectively and in a way that engages, inspires, and builds commitment to the Y’s cause.
Philanthropy: Secures resources and support to advance the Y’s.
Fiscal Management: Manages the Y’s resources responsibly and sustains the Y’s nonprofit business model.
Program/Project Management: Ensures program or project goals are met and intended impact occurs.
Developing Self & Others: Develops self and supports others (e.g., staff, volunteers, members, program participants), both formally and informally, to achieve their highest potential.

title: Overnight Supervisor
description:
Why choose us?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career? Join us for an exciting opportunity at Albertsons Companies, where innovation and customer service go hand-in-hand!

At Albertsons Companies, we are looking for someone who’s not just seeking a job, but someone who wants to make an impact. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to lead, innovate, and contribute to the growth of a company that values great service and lasting customer relationships. This position offers the chance to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that’s constantly evolving.


Position Summary

The Night Crew Supervisor provides leadership and direction to the overnight stock crew while supporting the efficient operation of the store. This position helps ensure freight is unloaded, sorted, stocked, faced, and completed accurately and on time. The Night Crew Supervisor maintains strong standards for productivity, organization, merchandising, safety, and store readiness while providing guidance and support to overnight associates.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide leadership and direction to Night Crew associates throughout the shift.
  • Coordinate the unloading, sorting, stocking, and organization of incoming freight.
  • Assign aisles, departments, and stocking responsibilities based on workload and business needs.
  • Monitor associate productivity and follow up to ensure assigned work is completed accurately and on time.
  • Stock merchandise efficiently while maintaining proper product placement and merchandising standards.
  • Ensure shelves are faced, organized, properly stocked, and ready for customers.
  • Maintain proper product rotation and follow established procedures to reduce out-of-stocks, damages, and shrink.
  • Identify backstock and ensure merchandise is properly organized and stored in designated areas.
  • Assist with breaking down loads, moving pallets, stocking cases, and completing freight when additional support is needed.
  • Monitor freight progress throughout the shift and adjust associate assignments as necessary.
  • Ensure aisles, backrooms, receiving areas, and workspaces remain clean, organized, and free of hazards.
  • Ensure cardboard, pallets, plastic, and other stocking materials are removed and handled appropriately.
  • Verify that department conditions meet established standards before the completion of the shift.
  • Identify damaged products, merchandise issues, or inventory concerns and communicate them to appropriate leadership.
  • Help maintain accurate pricing, tags, displays, and promotional merchandise when applicable.
  • Follow all company safety, sanitation, and workplace procedures.
  • Ensure associates use stocking equipment and other store equipment safely and appropriately.
  • Assist with opening, closing, and overnight store responsibilities as assigned.
  • Communicate incomplete freight, staffing concerns, equipment issues, and other operational needs to store leadership.
  • Support other departments and operational needs as necessary.
Leadership Expectations
  • Lead by example and maintain a professional, positive, and productive work environment.
  • Provide associates with clear assignments, expectations, and appropriate follow-up.
  • Keep the crew focused on productivity while maintaining accuracy and safety.
  • Train and coach associates on stocking procedures, productivity expectations, merchandise handling, and safety.
  • Monitor individual and team performance throughout the shift.
  • Recognize strong performance and address opportunities for improvement.
  • Adjust assignments and priorities based on freight volume, staffing, and store needs.
  • Promote teamwork, accountability, urgency, and effective communication.
  • Maintain a visible leadership presence and assist the crew when workload requires additional support.
  • Ensure the store is clean, organized, stocked, and prepared for business at the conclusion of the overnight shift.
Qualifications
  • Previous retail, grocery, stocking, warehouse, or related experience preferred.
  • Previous leadership or supervisory experience preferred.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to provide clear direction and effectively supervise multiple associates.
  • Ability to prioritize workloads and maintain productivity in a fast-paced environment.
  • Knowledge of stocking, merchandising, product rotation, and inventory practices preferred.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and make appropriate decisions during overnight operations.
  • Must be dependable, organized, professional, and able to demonstrate good judgment.
  • Ability to work an overnight schedule, including weekends and holidays, based on business needs.
Physical Requirements
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to bend, reach, squat, kneel, push, pull, and perform repetitive motions.
  • Ability to regularly lift and move cases, products, pallets, and store supplies as required.
  • Ability to operate stocking equipment and other store equipment after receiving appropriate training.
  • Ability to work in refrigerated, cooler, and freezer environments when necessary.
  • Ability to perform physically demanding stocking and freight responsibilities throughout the overnight shift.

title: Directeur, Finance Commerciale
description:
Directeur, Finance Commerciale

English version bellow

Poste à combler : Dès maintenant

Lieu : Montréal, QC – Québec, QC

Sous la supervision de la Cheffe de la direction financière (CFO), le Directeur Finance Commerciale est responsable de soutenir la croissance profitable de l’entreprise en agissant comme partenaire financier stratégique auprès des équipes des ventes, du marketing et de la direction.

Ce rôle agit comme leader financier de l’ensemble des activités commerciales en fournissant des analyses et recommandations liées à la stratégie de prix, à la rentabilité des clients et des produits, aux tendances de marché, à la performance du portefeuille de produits, à l’efficacité des canaux de vente ainsi qu’aux opportunités d’investissement et de croissance.

La personne retenue se distinguera par sa capacité à transformer des données complexes en recommandations financières stratégiques, concrètes et exploitables afin d’influencer les décisions d’affaires et de soutenir la croissance profitable de l’entreprise.

Elle combinera une solide expertise financière, une forte capacité analytique, un esprit stratégique et une aptitude reconnue à influencer les décideurs et à accompagner les équipes dans l’exécution des stratégies de croissance.

Principales responsabilités:

Partenariat d’affaires et stratégie commerciale

  • Agir comme principal partenaire financier des équipes commerciales et de la direction.
  • Soutenir l’élaboration et l’exécution de stratégies visant une croissance rentable des revenus.
  • Participer aux exercices de planification stratégique en fournissant des analyses financières et des recommandations d’affaires.
  • Valider les hypothèses d’affaires et assurer que les décisions commerciales reposent sur une analyse financière rigoureuse.
  • Développer de solides relations de partenariat avec les équipes des ventes, du marketing, des opérations, de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et de la direction.
  • Promouvoir une culture de responsabilité axée sur la croissance profitable et le rendement du capital investi.

Gestion des prix et des marges

  • Diriger les processus de gouvernance des prix à l’échelle de l’entreprise.
  • Développer des outils et cadres analytiques permettant d’évaluer les ajustements de prix, les négociations clients, les rabais, les remises et les programmes promotionnels.
  • Assurer le suivi de la réalisation des hausses de prix et identifier les opportunités d’amélioration des marges.
  • Évaluer les impacts financiers des mouvements de prix de la concurrence et des dynamiques de marché.
  • Collaborer avec les leaders des ventes afin d’optimiser les résultats commerciaux tout en respectant les objectifs de rentabilité.
  • Formuler des recommandations concernant les stratégies de prix, les renouvellements de contrats et les négociations avec les clients stratégiques.

Rentabilité clients et produits

  • Développer et maintenir des modèles de rentabilité par client, marché, produit, canal et région.
  • Identifier des opportunités d’amélioration de la marge brute et de la rentabilité des clients.
  • Évaluer l’économie des stratégies d’acquisition et de fidélisation de la clientèle.
  • Analyser la rentabilité par carrière, famille de produits, territoire et canal de vente.
  • Soutenir les décisions liées à l’optimisation du portefeuille de produits et à la priorisation des marchés.
  • Développer des rapports et indicateurs standardisés de performance commerciale.

Croissance des revenus et intelligence de marché

  • Analyser les tendances du marché, la demande des clients, les dynamiques concurrentielles et les facteurs macroéconomiques influençant les résultats de l’entreprise.
  • Réaliser des analyses de marché, de parts de marché et de potentiel de croissance.
  • Effectuer le suivi des indicateurs avancés et retardés de performance commerciale.
  • Soutenir le développement de stratégies commerciales à long terme et de plans de croissance.
  • Identifier les risques et les occasions émergentes pouvant influencer les revenus et la rentabilité.

Prévisions et gestion de la performance

  • Collaborer avec les équipes FP&A afin d’améliorer l’exactitude des prévisions de revenus.
  • Développer des modèles de prévision basés sur les principaux inducteurs des revenus, volumes, prix et marges.
  • Analyser la performance des ventes par rapport au budget, aux prévisions et aux résultats historiques.
  • Participer aux revues d’affaires mensuelles en fournissant des analyses commerciales pertinentes.
  • Traduire les résultats commerciaux et opérationnels en impacts financiers.
  • Développer des indicateurs de performance (KPI) favorisant la responsabilisation et la gestion efficace des résultats.

Données, analytique et intelligence d’affaires

  • Établir une source unique et fiable des données de performance commerciale.
  • Exploiter Power BI, D365 et les outils d’intelligence d’affaires afin de soutenir la prise de décision.
  • Développer des tableaux de bord et indicateurs permettant le suivi de la croissance des revenus, de la rentabilité des clients, de la réalisation des prix et de la performance des marchés.
  • Promouvoir une culture de prise de décision basée sur les données.

Qualifications

  • Baccalauréat en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires, économie, commerce ou domaine connexe (obligatoire).
  • Titre professionnel CPA, CFA, MBA ou équivalent (un atout important).
  • Nos partenaires d’affaires sont répartis partout en Amérique du Nord; par conséquent, une excellente maîtrise de l’anglais, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit, est nécessaire, tandis qu’une bonne connaissance du français, à l’oral et à l’écrit, constitue un atout important.

Expérience

  • Plus de 12 ans d’expérience progressive en finance, idéalement dans un environnement manufacturier.
  • Minimum de 5 ans dans un rôle de leadership en finance commerciale, finance stratégique, FP&A, gestion des revenus, stratégie de prix ou partenariat d’affaires.
  • Expérience à titre de partenaire financier auprès des équipes de ventes et des fonctions commerciales dans un environnement manufacturier, industriel, de produits de construction, minier, de matériaux de construction ou dans tout autre secteur B2B connexe.
  • Expérience dans l’élaboration de stratégies de tarification, la réalisation d’analyses de rentabilité ainsi que le développement de cas d’affaires liés aux investissements de croissance.
  • Expérience démontrée à soutenir les équipes de direction et à présenter de l’information financière à des parties prenantes de haut niveau.

Profil recherché

  • Solide expérience en finance commerciale, analyse des prix, rentabilité, parts de marché et croissance des revenus.
  • Excellente compréhension des leviers de croissance et des facteurs influençant la rentabilité.
  • Forte capacité analytique et aptitude à transformer des données complexes en recommandations d’affaires concrètes.
  • Maîtrise avancée de Power BI, de la modélisation financière et des outils d’analyse de données.
  • Excellentes habiletés de communication et d’influence auprès de différents niveaux de gestion.
  • Vision stratégique jumelée à une forte orientation vers l’exécution.
  • Grande aisance à travailler dans un environnement en évolution rapide et comportant un certain niveau d’ambiguïté.
  • Capacité à bâtir des partenariats solides et crédibles avec les équipes d’affaires.
  • Approche pratique, proactive et orientée vers les résultats.
  • Grande curiosité intellectuelle et volonté constante d’amélioration continue.

Avantages

  • Salaire concurrentiel
  • Horaire de travail flexible

  • Prise en charge des cotisations professionnelles ainsi que des formations requises pour le maintien de titre professionnel
  • Assurances invalidité long terme
  • Assurances soins santé
  • Programme d'aide aux employés
  • Plateforme télémédecine

Version en français plus haut

Position to be filled: Immediately

Position Summary

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), the Director, Commercial Finance is responsible for supporting the company's profitable growth by acting as a strategic finance business partner to the Sales, Marketing, and Executive Leadership teams.

This role serves as the financial leader for all commercial activities by providing analysis and recommendations related to pricing strategy, customer and product profitability, market trends, product portfolio performance, sales channel effectiveness, as well as growth and investment opportunities.

The successful candidate will distinguish themselves through their ability to transform complex data into strategic, actionable financial recommendations that influence business decisions and support the company's profitable growth.

They will combine strong financial expertise, advanced analytical capabilities, strategic thinking, and a proven ability to influence decision-makers and support teams in the execution of growth strategies.

Key Responsibilities

Business Partnership and Commercial Strategy

  • Act as the primary finance partner to commercial leadership teams and executive management.
  • Support the development and execution of strategies aimed at driving profitable revenue growth.
  • Participate in strategic planning activities by providing financial analysis and business recommendations.
  • Challenge business assumptions and ensure commercial decisions are supported by rigorous financial analysis.
  • Build strong partnerships with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, and Executive Leadership teams.
  • Promote a culture of accountability focused on profitable growth and return on invested capital.

Pricing and Margin Management

  • Lead pricing governance processes across the organization.
  • Develop analytical tools and frameworks to evaluate pricing actions, customer negotiations, rebates, discounts, and promotional programs.
  • Monitor pricing realization and identify opportunities for margin improvement.
  • Assess the financial impact of competitive pricing actions and market dynamics.
  • Partner with Sales leaders to optimize commercial outcomes while maintaining profitability objectives.
  • Provide recommendations regarding pricing strategies, contract renewals, and key customer negotiations.

Customer and Product Profitability

  • Develop and maintain profitability models by customer, market, product, channel, and region.
  • Identify opportunities to improve gross margin and customer profitability.
  • Evaluate the economics of customer acquisition and retention strategies.
  • Analyze profitability by quarry, product family, territory, and sales channel.
  • Support decisions related to product portfolio optimization and market prioritization.
  • Develop standardized commercial performance reporting and KPIs.

Revenue Growth and Market Intelligence

  • Analyze market trends, customer demand, competitive dynamics, and macroeconomic factors impacting business performance.
  • Conduct market sizing, market share, and growth opportunity analyses.
  • Monitor leading and lagging indicators of commercial performance.
  • Support the development of long-term commercial strategies and growth plans.
  • Identify emerging risks and opportunities that may impact revenue and profitability.

Forecasting and Performance Management

  • Partner with the FP&A team to improve revenue forecast accuracy.
  • Develop forecasting models based on key revenue, volume, pricing, and margin drivers.
  • Analyze sales performance against budget, forecast, and prior-year results.
  • Participate in monthly business reviews and provide relevant commercial insights.
  • Translate commercial and operational performance into financial implications.
  • Develop KPIs that support accountability and effective performance management.

Data, Analytics and Business Intelligence

  • Establish a single, reliable source of truth for commercial performance data.
  • Leverage Power BI, D365, and business intelligence tools to support decision-making.
  • Develop dashboards and KPIs to monitor revenue growth, customer profitability, pricing realization, and market performance.
  • Promote a data-driven decision-making culture across the organization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Commerce, or a related field (required).
  • CPA, CFA, MBA, or equivalent professional designation is considered a strong asset.
  • Our business partners are located around North America; therefore, excellent English communication skills (spoken and written) are required, while a good knowledge of French (spoken and written) is considered a strong asset.

Experience

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in finance, ideally within a manufacturing environment.
  • Minimum of 5 years in a leadership role involving commercial finance, strategic finance, FP&A, revenue management, pricing strategy, or business partnering.
  • Experience serving as a finance business partner to sales organizations and commercial functions within manufacturing, industrial, building products, mining, construction materials, or related B2B industries.
  • Experience developing pricing strategies, conducting profitability analyses, and building business cases for growth investments.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting executive leadership teams and presenting financial information to senior stakeholders.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Strong experience in commercial finance, pricing analysis, profitability management, market share analysis, and revenue growth.
  • Solid understanding of growth drivers and factors affecting profitability.
  • Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to transform complex data into actionable business recommendations.
  • Advanced proficiency in Power BI, financial modeling, and data analytics tools.
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills across multiple levels of management.

title: DIRECTOR OF CLINICAL SERVICES
description:
Home: Southbridge Ottawa LTC
Location: Ottawa, Ontario
Position: Director of Clinical Services
Salary Range: $95,000-$100,000
Status: Permanent full-time, Vacancy,

Welcome Home!
Southbridge Care Homes provides exceptional acquisition, management, and redevelopment services for long-term care homes and retirement communities across Ontario. Our mission is to maintain a best-in-class portfolio that consistently delivers excellence in care and services while ensuring economic sustainability.
Reporting to the Director of Care, the Director of Clinical Services (ADOC) supports the Director of Care in managing all aspects of nursing services within the home. The Director of Clinicals Services ensures the delivery of high-quality resident care by promoting best practices, maintaining compliance with legislative and budgetary requirements, and supporting an interdisciplinary approach to care.
This is a full-time position based in a professional office environment. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, with occasional need for overtime during peak periods. The role involves prolonged periods of sitting and working on a computer. The employee must be able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced, team-oriented setting.

Key Responsibilities:

Assist the Director of Care in implementing and evaluating quality improvement initiatives, risk management systems, data collection and analysis, report writing, and procedural updates within the nursing department.
Lead the coordination and implementation of best practice and risk management programs related to resident care (e.g., falls prevention, restraint reduction, wound management, infection control).
Monitor and manage the effective utilization of nursing supplies and resources.
Oversee the High Intensity Needs (HIN) program and ensure appropriate resident support and documentation.
Maintain systems for resident care assessment, planning, implementation, and evaluation at both the resident and unit levels, maximizing staff resources and supporting Southbridge Pinewood’s interdisciplinary approach.
Support and oversee the RAI-MDS program to ensure accuracy and compliance.
Maintain an active, visible presence in resident home areas, mentoring staff and monitoring the provision of quality care.
Investigate and implement corrective actions related to occupational health and safety; develop and monitor modified work programs for nursing staff as required.
Collaborate with the Director of Care on special projects, reviews, audits, and other assigned duties.
Assume responsibility for the nursing department in the absence of the Director of Care.

Knowledge and Skills Required:

Registered Nurse (RN) in good standing with the College of Nurses of Ontario (CNO)
Minimum of three years of experience in long-term care; previous management or leadership experience is an asset.
Strong knowledge of geriatric care, infection prevention and control, adult education principles, and quality improvement processes.
Proficient in RAI-MDS and computerized resident care systems.
Demonstrated leadership, organizational, and communication skills (both verbal and written).
Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and other clinical software applications.
Knowledge of applicable legislation, current nursing standards, and healthcare practices, with a demonstrated commitment to providing quality resident-centered care.
Flexibility to participate in the manager on-call rotation schedule. More information will be provided during the interview process.
A negative vulnerable sector check completed within 6 months of hire date.
Completion of a 2 Step TB Skin test within the last 12 months.

Southbridge welcomes those applicants with disability related needs and those whom a need for accommodation in the recruitment process. Please provide notice of your need for accommodation to the hiring manager upon scheduling of an interview.

title: Journeyperson / New Mexico
description:
SCOPE OF WORK
Ability to lead and perform installations, alterations, additions, and/or repairs of electrical systems, conductors, and associated materials and equipment within the residential, commercial, and industrial electrical industry.
Proficient in troubleshooting and proactively problem-solving electrical systems.
POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Uses Gaylor Values as tools to carry out all job responsibilities
Understands and complies with Company and job safety requirements (O.S.H.A.)
Understands and follows lock out tag out procedures
Acquires and maintains personal hand tools per Company policy
Certified to operate platform and boom lifts, or able to obtain certification upon hire
Able to perform work at various heights, up to 90’, from ladders, scaffolds, aerial lifts, cat walks, roofs, or other designated safe work areas
Works from all assigned types of mobile elevated work platforms
Able to accurately bend and install all types of conduit

Understands use of degrees in bending conduit (i.e. concentric bending)

Able to use two handed tools/equipment (i.e. cable cutters, hammer drills, compression tools, jack hammers, etc.)
Understands and has ability to properly erect pulley systems to lift/move heavy equipment
Possesses knowledge of and ability to properly give “hand signals” to operators
Understands various types of switching of branch circuits (i.e. 3-way, 4-way, etc.)
Possesses knowledge of circuit grounding practices, transformer connections, over-current protection, parallel circuits, fuse/circuit breakers, motors, cable trays and their supports
Possesses knowledge of effects of soil on underground installations and cables
Possesses knowledge of trench safety required during installation of underground conductors

Possesses knowledge of other trades, including concrete, masonry, metals, and wood construction methods
Possesses skill to accurately plan and install conductors in conduits and raceways
Possesses knowledge of and ability to accurately install electrical devices and fixtures in a timely manner
Able to work in restrictive/tight areas (i.e. switchgear rooms, crawl spaces, utility tunnels, attics, etc.)
Able to install switchgear and perform the required terminations
Has experience in terminations/splicing up to and including 600 volts
Possesses technical knowledge, safety knowledge, and ability to work with live and energized parts
Leads and assists in all types of wire pulls (i.e. conduit, cable tray, floor ducts, wire way, etc.)
Understands verbal instructions and heeds safety warnings
Demonstrates and exhibits proper use and safe handling of tools, equipment, and materials
Reads and understands labels, job site maps/directions, instruction manuals, and written instructions
Possesses knowledge of blueprints, shop drawings, ladder logic diagrams, and has ability to visualize completed work prior to installation

Understands and complies with NEC, state, and local codes

Understand basic math and can properly read tape measure

Able to add, subtract, divide, multiply, and accurately use electrical formulas

Takes pride in craftsmanship

RESPONSIBILITIES

Reports to assigned job site location on time, as directed
Maintains and properly stores tools, materials, and equipment
Organizes materials and tools to maintain clean and neat work area
Possesses ability to dig trenches, either by use of hand tools or equipment as necessary
Mounts and installs assigned hardware (such as conduit, wires, and strapping) as directed
Accurately identifies colors of wires and conductors
Plans, schedules, and organizes tasks to meet deadlines
Accurately interprets electrical construction drawings, terminates cables, installs, and trouble shoots control wiring from schematics
Completes routine daily inspections of equipment and work areas to verify accurate and timely installations
Completes and documents regular safety inspections, as assigned
Accurately and effectively directs and trains Helpers and Apprentices in proper work practices to meet production requirements
Safely performs assigned tasks with limited supervision

WORKING CONDITIONS

May require working in all elements (heat, cold, rain, snow, etc.) depending on job location and/or time of year

Must be able to utilize construction site sanitary facilities (port-o-lets)
Must have required hand tools at all times while at work site (waist tool belts can weigh up to 30 lbs.)
Must be able to work scheduled hours as well as overtime, as required, on short notice
Must be able to work in noisy environments
Must be able to remain calm in times of heightened emotional situations
Must work well with others as a member of a team to complete tasks

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Must be able to wear personnel protective equipment (i.e., hard hat, safety glasses, gloves, high visibility vest, safety harness, etc.) when required
Ability to stand, bend, stoop, squat, crawl, climb, kneel, balance, push, pull, and reach overhead for extended periods of time
Ability to lift loads of up to 51 lbs.
Repetitive use of arms, hands, and fingers
Ability to climb and use ladders and scaffolding of all types for extended periods of time
Possess good vision/hearing (normal or corrected)
Ability to make transition from designated employee parking areas to construction areas and be able to gain access to all levels of building/structure, even if only means of access is by OSHA approved site construction ladder or stairs still under construction but deemed safe for use
Ability to work while constantly moving
Ability to reach and stretch to position equipment, fixtures, etc. while maintaining balance
Ability to use both hands simultaneously for tying knots and for proper use of power equipment
Must be able to see color to discern color-coded wiring
Must be physically capable of pulling wires and cables through conduits

EDUCATION

High School graduate or equivalency, preferred

EXPERIENCE

Accredited Apprenticeship Program completion or six years on the job electrical experience required
Journeyman License requirement in states, locales, or projects, as required

title: Director of Operations & Supply Chain
description:
Hi-Altitude Brands | Health & Wellness | Remote (PST/MST Based)

About Hi-Altitude Brands

Hi-Altitude Brands, through our flagship brand, Stonehenge Health, is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer supplement company on a mission to help people live healthier, more vibrant lives. We develop premium, science-backed formulations featuring clinically studied branded ingredients that set us apart from competitors. Our products are sold through our website, Amazon, and Walmart, reaching hundreds of thousands of customers nationwide.

We are a fully remote team that values autonomy, ownership, and results. We move fast, test constantly, and hold ourselves to high standards. If you thrive in environments where your work has a direct, measurable impact, you will fit right in.

Position Overview

We are looking for an exceptional Director of Operations & Supply Chain to build and lead the operational backbone of a fast-growing consumer business.

You’ll own contract manufacturing, sourcing and procurement, demand and supply planning, and 3PL operations—building the processes and systems needed to scale efficiently and reliably. You’ll also support the company’s ERP transition and strengthen inventory accuracy, master data, and reporting.

This role sits at the center of the business, partnering closely with Product Development, Marketing, Finance & Accounting, 3PL/fulfillment, and Customer Experience. You’ll report directly to and work closely with the COO.

Responsibilities

Sourcing & Supplier Management:

● Develop and execute sourcing strategies that optimize cost, quality, supply continuity, and risk.

● Lead supplier selection, negotiation, qualification, onboarding, and ongoing relationship management.

● Manage contract manufacturing partners, supplier performance, cost reduction initiatives, and sourcing for new product launches.

● Monitor market and geopolitical risks to proactively identify and mitigate supply disruptions.

Procurement & Planning:

● Own procurement processes, including RFQs, purchasing, P2P workflows, and procurement KPIs.

● Lead demand and supply planning across channels, including forecasting, inventory levels,

purchasing, and excess/obsolete inventory management.

● Analyze demand, lead times, landed costs, and supply trends to identify opportunities for

improvement.

3PL, Logistics & Inventory:

● Manage 3PL, carrier, and freight-forwarder relationships and ensure performance against service

expectations.

● Maintain inventory accuracy, landed COGS, and product/master data across systems.

● Oversee inbound and outbound inventory flow, freight, and logistics operations.

Project & Team Leadership:

● Lead cross-functional supply chain and operations projects, managing priorities, timelines, risks, and

stakeholder communication.

● Establish scalable operation rhythms across planning, procurement, and resource management.

● Own the operations budget and serve as a strategic operating partner to the COO.

● Lead and develop the Supply Chain and Project Management teams.

What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)

● A reliable demand and supply planning process that improves inventory availability while reducing out-of-stocks and excess inventory.

● A strong contract manufacturing and supplier network with clear performance standards, sourcing strategies, and supply continuity plans in place.

● A strategic sourcing program delivering measurable cost savings across the vendor base.

● A consolidated demand plan and standardized planning processes across the business.

● Accurate, standardized master data and product structures ready to support the ERP transition.

Requirements

● 7–10+ years of operations and supply chain leadership, ideally within high-growth consumer products, DTC, or e-commerce.

● Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, business, operations, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.

● Deep experience managing contract manufacturers and suppliers, including sourcing, negotiation, pricing, performance management, and supply continuity.

● Proven track record in strategic sourcing and delivering measurable cost savings.

● Strong demand and supply planning expertise, including forecasting, inventory strategy, and planning processes built from the ground up.

● Strong 3PL, fulfillment, and logistics partner management capabilities.

● Exposure to ERP implementations, systems transitions, or similar operational transformations.

● Proven people leader with strong analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

What We Offer

● A genuine build mandate with the autonomy to match, at a growing brand where the work is

visible and the impact is real.

● Direct partnership with the COO and a seat at the table for decisions that shape the

operation.

● Fully remote, US-based, with a team that operates on ownership rather than oversight.

Compensation

Competitive salary range of $150,000-175,000 per year, plus bonus eligibility

Benefits

● Flexible time off + 9 annual company holidays

● Your Birthday is a paid vacation day - take the day to celebrate your awesomeness!

● 100% company-paid base plan Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance for employees

● 100% company-paid Life Insurance and Short-Term Disability Coverage

● 3% Employer contributions to 401(k) regardless of employee participation! (Free

money)

● Matching Charitable Contributions up to $2,500/year

● $1,200/annual Work from Home (WFH) stipend

● Employee Recognition and Rewards Program

● Pet insurance

● Employee Product Samples and Discounts

● Professional Development Fund

● Free Calm App Subscription

Hi-Altitude Brands is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating

an inclusive, welcoming environment for all

title: Data Engineer z GCP (f/m/x)
description:
Data Engineer z GCP (f/m/x)

Miejsce pracy: Piła

Technologie, których używamy

  • BigQuery
  • Cloud Computing
  • SQL
  • Python
  • IaC (Infrastructure as Code)
  • Google Cloud Platform

Mile widziane

  • Apache Airflow / Cloud Composer
  • Terraform
  • Data Built Tool
  • Apache Spark
  • Databricks
  • Snowflake
  • Microsoft Fabric

O projekcie

Chcesz rozwijać się w technologiach chmurowych i pracować na realnych danych? Dołącz do naszego zespołu Data & Analytics, gdzie budujemy i rozwijamy rozwiązania oparte na GCP. Pracuj z ekspertami, rozwijaj się w kierunku Data Engineeringu, Big Data lub Machine Learningu i miej realny wpływ na projekty.

Twój zakres obowiązków

  • Projektowanie, implementacja i utrzymanie skalowalnych pipeline’ów danych w oparciu o Google Cloud Platform
  • Praca z BigQuery jako główną hurtownią danych: modelowanie danych, optymalizacja zapytań i kosztów, dbanie o wydajność oraz niezawodność rozwiązań
  • Integracja danych z różnych źródeł (pliki, bazy danych, API, eventy) oraz ich przetwarzanie i transformacja
  • Orkiestracja workflow danych przy użyciu Apache Airflow / Cloud Composer
  • Tworzenie i utrzymanie rozwiązań CI/CD dla pipeline’ów danych oraz infrastruktury
  • Zarządzanie infrastrukturą w chmurze zgodnie z podejściem Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
  • Zapewnienie jakości danych, monitoringu pipeline’ów oraz szybkiego reagowania na incydenty
  • Współpraca z zespołami analitycznymi, BI i produktowymi w celu dostarczania stabilnych i dobrze udokumentowanych danych
  • Udział w rozwoju architektury danych oraz wspólne definiowanie dobrych praktyk data engineeringowych

Nasze wymagania

  • Min. 4 lata doświadczenia w roli Data Engineer lub na podobnym stanowisku przy pracy z danymi w środowisku produkcyjnym
  • Bardzo dobra znajomość Google Cloud Platform, w szczególności: BigQuery (modelowanie danych, optymalizacja zapytań) oraz Cloud Storage
  • Umiejętność projektowania, budowy i utrzymania pipeline’ów danych (batch i/lub streaming)
  • Bardzo dobra znajomość SQL oraz Pythona w kontekście przetwarzania i orkiestracji danych
  • Doświadczenie w obszarze orkiestracji workflow (Apache Airflow / Cloud Composer)
  • Praktyka w implementacji CI/CD dla rozwiązań data, np. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Cloud Build
  • Znajomość podejścia Infrastructure as Code, ze wskazaniem na Terraform
  • Wcześniejsza praca z dużymi wolumenami danych, z uwzględnieniem wydajności i niezawodności rozwiązań
  • Swobodna komunikacja w języku angielskim
  • Wymagane przebywanie na terenie Polski oraz płynna znajomość języka polskiego

Mile widziane

  • Praktyczne doświadczenie w przetwarzaniu danych streamingowych (np. Dataflow / Apache Beam, Pub/Sub)
  • Biegłość w Apache Spark / PySpark przy pracy z dużymi wolumenami danych
  • Kompetencje w zakresie transformacji i modelowania danych z wykorzystaniem narzędzi takich jak dbt
  • Umiejętność pracy z różnorodnymi platformami danych (np. Databricks, Snowflake, MS Fabric)
  • Orientacja w narzędziach oraz dobrych praktykach z obszaru Data Governance, Data Lineage i Data Quality

To oferujemy

  • Tytuł Great Place to Work od 2015 roku - to dzięki opiniom pracowników otrzymujemy tytuł i wdrażamy nowe pomysły
  • Stabilność zatrudnienia – 2,1 MLD PLN przychodu, brak długów, od 2006 roku na rynku
  • Dzielimy się zyskiem z pracownikami - od 2022 roku przeznaczyliśmy na ten cel już ponad 76 milionów PLN

title: Project Manager
description:
